jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) is the executive leader responsible for using enterprise data, advanced analytics, AI, and business intelligence to improve strategic and operational decision-making.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) is the executive leader responsible for using enterprise data, advanced analytics, AI, and business intelligence to improve strategic and operational decision-making.

Within Insurance & Investments, the CAO typically oversees analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer intelligence, fraud, risk, actuarial insights, investment performance, portfolio analytics, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the organization's enterprise analytics strategy.

Establish an enterprise-wide analytics operating model, roadmap, standards, and priorities.

Lead advanced analytics, predictive analytics, AI/ML, data science, and business intelligence.

Translate complex data into actionable insights for CEO, Board, executives, and business leaders.

Develop analytics capabilities for:

Underwriting and risk selection

Claims and loss analysis

Pricing and profitability

Customer segmentation and retention

Fraud detection

Risk and capital analytics

Portfolio and investment performance

Asset allocation

Market and investment research

Financial forecasting

Regulatory and management reporting

Establish enterprise analytics KPIs and measurement frameworks.

Drive predictive modelling and scenario analysis to support strategic decisions.

Partner with the CIO/CDO/CTO on data architecture, data platforms, governance, integration, and technology modernization.

Ensure analytical models use reliable, governed, secure, and appropriately controlled data.

Develop self-service BI and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities for AI and automation across business functions.

Establish model governance, validation, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.

Support actuarial, risk, finance, investment, compliance, and executive decision-making.

Lead enterprise analytics transformation and data-driven culture.

Build, manage, and develop high-performing teams across analytics, data science, BI, and AI.

Manage analytics budgets, vendors, strategic technology partners, and external data providers.

Communicate analytical findings and business implications to senior executives and the Board.

Ensure analytics activities align with regulatory, privacy, risk, and financial-services requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of experience across analytics, data science, BI, statistics, quantitative analysis, or related fields.

7+ years in senior analytics/data leadership.

Previous experience as:

Chief Analytics Officer

Chief Data & Analytics Officer

Chief Data Officer

Head of Data & Analytics

Head of Analytics

Group Head of Analytics

Director of Data & Analytics

Analytics Director

VP Data & Analytics

Strong experience in Insurance, Banking, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services.

Strong understanding of:

Advanced analytics

Predictive modelling

AI/ML

Data science

Business intelligence

Data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

Statistical modelling

Data visualization

Scenario/stress testing

Experience converting analytics into measurable business outcomes.

Strong executive stakeholder management and Board-level communication.

Experience leading large, multidisciplinary analytics/data teams.

Strong commercial and strategic understanding of financial-services businesses.

Bachelor's degree required; Master's/PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, or a related field is advantageous.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Accounts Receivable Senior Representative is responsible for all aspects of follow-up activity, to include taking appropriate steps to resolve accounts timely. This candidate should have an increased knowledge of the Revenue Cycle as it relates to the entire life of a patient account from creation to expected payment. Representative will need to effectively follow-up on claim submission and; remittance review for insurance collections, create and pursue disputed balances from both government and non-government entities. Basic knowledge of Commercial, Managed Care, Medicare and Medicaid insurance is preferable. . Participate and assist in special projects as well as provide A/R support to the team. Assist new or existing staff with training or techniques to increase production and quality as well as provide A/R support for the team members that may be absent or backlogged. An effective revenue cycle process is achieved with working as part of a dynamic team and the ability to adapt and grow in an environment where work assignments may change frequently while resolving more complex accounts with minimal or no assistance.

Senior Representative must have the ability to work closely with management and team members working an inventory of collectible accounts that bring in revenue and possess the the following:

  • Conduct telephone calls utilizing a professional demeanor when contacting payors and/or patients in order to obtain collection related information
  • Basic computer skills to navigate through the various system applications provided for additional resources in determining account actions (may work in multiple systems for clients)
  • Access payer websites and discern pertinent data to resolve accounts
  • Utilize all available job aids provided for appropriateness in follow-up processes
  • Document clear and concise notes in the patient accounting system regarding claim status and any actions taken on an account
  • Maintain department daily productivity goals in completing a set number of accounts while also meeting quality standards as determined by leadership
  • Skilled in working with complex medical claim issues
  • Identify and communicate any issues including system access, payor behavior, account/work-flow inconsistencies or any other insurance collection opportunities
  • Compile data to substantiate and utilize to resolve payer, system or escalated account issues
  • Assist new or existing staff with training or techniques to increase production and quality
  • Provide support for team members that may be absent or backlogged

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Researches each account using company patient accounting applications and internet resources that are made available. Conducts appropriate account activity on uncollected account balances with contacting third party payors and/or patients via phone, e-mail, or online. Problem solves issues and creates resolution that will bring in revenue eliminating re-work. Updates plan IDs, adjusts patient or payor demographic/insurance information, notates account in detail, identifies payor issues and trends and and solves re-coup issues. Requests additional information from patients, medical records, and other needed documentation upon request from payors. Reviews contracts and identify billing or coding issues and request re-bills, secondary billing, or corrected bills as needed. Takes appropriate action to bring about account resolution timely or opens a dispute record to have the account further researched and substantiated for continued collection. Maintains desk inventory to remain current without backlog while achieving productivity and quality standards.
  • Perform special projects and other duties as needed. Assists with special projects as assigned, documents findings, and communicates results to leaders.
  • Recognizes potential delays and trends with payors such as corrective actions and responds to avoid A/R aging. Escalates payment delays/ problem aged account timely to Supervisor.
  • Compile data to substantiate and utilize to resolve payer, system or escalated account issues.
  • Assist new or existing staff with training or techniques to increase production and quality as needed.
  • Participate and attend meetings, training seminars and in-services to develop job knowledge.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Thorough understanding of the revenue cycle process, from patient access (authorization, admissions) through Patient Financial Services (billing, insurance appeals, collections) procedures and policies
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Intermediate technical skills including PC and MS Outlook
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Above average analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to make sound decisions
  • Has a full understanding of the Commercial, Managed Care, Medicare and Medicaid collections, Intermediate knowledge of Managed Care contracts, Contract Language and Federal and State requirements for government payors
  • Advanced knowledge of UB-04 and Explanation of Benefits (EOB) interpretation
  • Intermediate knowledge of CPT and ICD-9 codes
  • Advanced knowledge of insurance billing, collections and insurance terminology

This may include, but is not limited to, the COVID-19 vaccination, influenza vaccination, and/or any future required vaccines and screenings.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Include minimum education, technical training, and/or experience required to perform the job.

  • High school diploma or equivalent education
  • 2-5 years experience in Medical/Hospital Insurance related collections

  • Office/Teamwork Environment

About The Wilkinson Firm

TWF is a workforce strategy and staffing firm. Year 2 of operations. Our HR Advisory practice serves behavioral health and mental health providers across the Southeast. We are building a senior clinical bench - operators who have led clinical functions at scale and want to put their expertise to work in a portfolio-career model that respects their time.

Who we want

Former Clinical Directors, Medical Directors, Chief Clinical Officers, VP Clinical Services, or Executive Directors at CMHCs, FQHCs, IDD agencies, hospital BH service lines, MSOs, or state BH authorities. You have led clinical organizations, owned clinical P&L, navigated CARF surveys, Medicaid SPA mechanics, CMS Conditions of Participation, and clinical workforce strategy. $0 base. $150-300/hr when engaged. 10% referral fee on first-year revenue from sourced clients. Optional phantom equity grant (0.05-0.25%) for named senior seats. Public credit on firm advisor page with your consent. Long-term founding-team consideration possible for the right operator.

Send CV, clinical license, and one-paragraph note on a BH client system you have led to with subject "Clinical Director BH." Reply within 48 hours.

jobs.description:
Corporate Technology

Michael Baker International understands that people require choices in where they want to build a sustainable future. For more than 85 years, Michael Baker International has maintained an entrepreneurial work environment that fosters great careers and brings great success to the organization. Michael Baker offers many opportunities to grow professionally — whether in Finance, IT, Human Resources, Technology, Communications, or our National Practice and Market segments. Take your next step with us and help make a difference in the lives of those you work with and those we serve.

What We're Looking For

Michael Baker International is seeking a Senior Microsoft AI Developer to join our CTO organization in a fully remote capacity. In this role, you will design and deliver enterprise-grade AI-capable applications and Copilot Studio agents that enable the organization to scale intelligent solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem. You will partner closely with IT, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Legal, and business stakeholders to build, govern, and continuously improve AI-powered solutions — driving meaningful adoption and measurable business impact.

This is a development-focused role. You will own the engineering and delivery of AI solutions built on Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and the Microsoft Power Platform, working alongside a dedicated Power Platform Administrator who owns tenant governance and the Center of Excellence (CoE) Toolkit.

This is a fully remote position supporting the United States. Michael Baker International does not sponsor employment visas for this position.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain Copilot Studio agents — including topics, actions, tools, orchestration, connectors, and knowledge grounding — integrated with enterprise data sources, Microsoft 365, and line-of-business systems
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns against enterprise content in SharePoint, Dataverse, and other MBI systems to keep agent responses accurate and traceable
  • Develop and deploy generative AI solutions on Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI, including model selection, prompt engineering, and systematic output evaluation
  • Build and consume Azure AI and Azure OpenAI APIs in Python to extend Copilot Studio agents and custom applications beyond out-of-the-box platform capabilities
  • Develop supporting Power Apps and Power Automate flows where they are the right delivery vehicle for an AI-enabled use case
  • Implement responsible AI practices — including input validation, prompt injection defense, and security guardrails — as first-class engineering requirements
  • Partner with Data & AI teams to align solutions with the organization's broader GenAI and Azure AI strategy
  • Support proof-of-concepts (PoCs), pilots, MVPs, and production deployments of AI-capable applications; document architectural patterns and manage solution assets in source control
  • Provide technical guidance, training, and enablement to makers, developers, and business stakeholders building AI solutions
  • Promote engineering best practices including source control discipline, automated build and release pipelines, and solution performance and maintainability standards
  • Track usage and impact of deployed agents and AI solutions; use insights to drive continuous improvement

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years of experience with Microsoft technologies, including hands-on application development
  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying Copilot Studio agents in an enterprise environment
  • Strong experience developing solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
  • Proficiency in Python for developing, integrating, and automating AI solutions and services
  • Demonstrated experience with source control and modern deployment practices including Git, branching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering, RAG patterns, grounding, and evaluation of generative AI output
  • Experience integrating solutions with Microsoft 365, Azure services, and external APIs
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry model catalog, Azure Fabric (including Databricks), or enterprise GenAI platforms
  • Experience with Power Platform extensibility — custom connectors, Azure Functions, REST APIs
  • Background supporting large-scale citizen developer or maker programs
  • Microsoft certifications (Azure AI Engineer Associate, Power Platform Developer Associate, or related)
  • Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks, AI governance standards, or AI security practices

Job Description

WHAT TO EXPECT AS A WALDEN FACULTY MEMBER
Faculty members educate Walden University students by effectively and proficiently using online technology and resources so that knowledge, information, feedback, and critique are imparted to and shared with students in thoughtful, carefully formulated, well written, and timely communications. Faculty are required to grade assignments, participate in discussions, respond to student emails, use technology designed to enhance the learning experience for students. This is accomplished in an environment that is respectful of the student, the faculty member, Walden University, and the discipline in which the faculty member is involved.

TRAINING

All new faculty members receive specific training from Walden University in the techniques of online teaching; use of an electronic learning platform; specifics of the policies, procedures, and degree programs of the School or College in which they are going to teach; socialization into the Walden University culture; assessment of academic integrity of student work; and research supervision of theses and dissertations. Teaching and mentorship assignments are contingent upon successful completion of required training. During the first term of teaching, faculty members may be assigned a faculty peer mentor (senior colleague) as an extension of their new instructor training. Peer mentors will continue to support instruction and provide peer reviews of the classroom on a regular basis.

COURSE/ TEACHING AVAILABILITY
Faculty members are assigned courses, which are taught using Blackboard, and are responsible for interacting with students within Blackboard. Discussion Boards for classrooms are open 24 hrs/day, 7 days/wk. Faculty members are expected to be in the classroom a minimum of 4 days/wk and responses to student questions must be posted within 48 hrs. The university suggests regular and predictable availability, such as online office hours or regular online chats; office hours may be required based on program or college policy.

  • MSN in the field of Nursing. Required
  • DNP or PhD in the field of Nursing is also accepted.
  • 1+ years of teaching experience.Preferred.
  • 1+ years online or technology-enabled instruction experience.
  • At least 1 year of current practice experience as a PNP or FNP is required. 
  • RN and APRN License in at least 1 of the 50 states is required
  • Must be willing to acquire a Minnesota RN and APRN license. This license is a requirement for teaching in the MSN NP program
  • Faculty members are required to have an adequate computer to handle an electronic learning platform, keyboard, pointing device, and computer monitor. All other tools are knowledge-based or training-based through Walden University. The Faculty Member must be able to use Microsoft Office products (MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint), zip software, and Adobe Acrobat and must have reliable Internet access as well as alternate access in cases where primary access becomes unavailable.
  • Candidates should possess a significant record of intellectual and professional contributions to the field of Pediatrics
  • Commitment to advocating for the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment.
  • Teaching, advising and mentoring; commitment to the promotion of applied research and the recruitment and development of a diverse faculty; excellent leadership, communication, team, and human relations skills.
  • Experience with distance learning is preferred.
  • Faculty Members must be appropriately credentialed, possess an earned degree from an accredited institution or recognized by a country's ministry of education in the discipline being taught, and may be expected to be licensed or license-eligible in order to teach in specific programs.

About us

Pomelo Care is the leading virtual medical practice for women and children, providing care across pregnancy, postpartum, pediatrics, menopause, and perimenopause. We combine proactive, 24/7 clinical care with technology that helps us reach patients earlier, identify risks sooner, and deliver personalized care throughout their journey. Our team includes clinicians, technologists, operators, and problem-solvers working together to make high-quality care more accessible for families nationwide.

About The Role:

Your north star: Own how Pomelo's clinical and economic impact is measured, proven, and presented - to our payer partners, to external partners, and in published research. We're looking for a data scientist experienced in healthcare outcomes assessment or program evaluation to join our Health Economics team. Trustworthy, actionable data plays a critical role in Pomelo's mission to improve pregnancy outcomes.

Why this role matters: This role goes far beyond reporting. The analyses you produce feed directly into renewal and expansion negotiations with national payers, shape how new risk-based and value-based offerings are structured, and become the evidence base we publish. You'll inherit a strong foundation of established methods and infrastructure, and you'll regularly need to build on it to answer novel questions, explore new methodologies, and communicate results to audiences with very different backgrounds. You will have direct influence on how we measure impact and tell our story externally.

What you'll do:

  • Own the question as well as the analysis. Take large, ambiguous mandates and break them into definitions, assumptions, and key questions to align stakeholders
  • Architect and execute analyses that assess the outcomes of Pomelo Care's programs in a scalable, repeatable way. Where existing approaches don't reach, you'll extend them or build something new, and stand behind those choices under scrutiny
  • Lead Pomelo's technical engagement with external partners: presenting directly, aligning on methodology and parameters, and building credibility with evaluation teams
  • Drive our evidence strategy end to end: partner-facing reporting, conference presentations, and peer-reviewed publications
  • Build data tables, pipelines, and dashboards that combine diverse health data sources and make insights accessible across teams
  • Identify opportunities to scale and automate insights in partnership with the data and analytics engineering teams
  • Serve as Pomelo's expert on statistics and health economics: define the methodologies we use for evaluation, mentor other data scientists, and guide where we invest technically

Who you are:

You are a collaborative problem solver and analytic thinker who is focused on driving impact, and excited to work at a startup. Specifically,

  • 6+ years professional experience developing statistical models to answer complex healthcare problems using varied techniques (e.g., propensity score matching, linear and logistic regressions, k-means clustering, difference-in-differences, decision trees)
  • Experience with cost of care or clinical outcomes target setting at a payer, managed care organization, integrated delivery network, value-based care provider, or healthcare consulting firm
  • Experience presenting statistical analyses to external stakeholders with varied technical expertise
  • Proficient in Python or R
  • Proficient in SQL
  • You do your best work when the goal is ambiguous. You are comfortable telling others "here's what I recommend and why" rather than waiting to be told what to analyze
  • You have the technical depth to run a publication-grade evaluation and the judgment to know when a scrappy proof-of-concept is the better call. You never lose sight of why the work matters to the business
  • Excellent written and verbal communicator, comfortable across technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus points if you have any of the following

  • Formal training in statistics, econometrics, or actuarial science
  • Experience with risk-based or value-based contracting, including opportunity sizing and ROI modeling
  • Experience with medical claims data
  • Peer-reviewed publications in health outcomes or health economics
  • Experience with data dashboarding or visualization (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Metabase)
  • Experience working with dbt

Why you should join our team

By joining Pomelo, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast-moving, well-funded, and mission-driven startup that always puts the patient first. You will learn, grow and be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.

We strive to create an environment where employees from all backgrounds are respected. We value working across disciplines, moving fast, data-driven decision making, learning, and always putting the patient first.

  • High deductible Health Plans with Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Equity grant participation
  • 401(k) program
  • Competitive vacation policy
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • Fully remote work flexibility (within the US)

Compensation:

The expected base salary range offered for this role is $220,000 - $250,000. This role is also eligible for equity, giving you an ownership stake in Pomelo’s mission. Actual compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

At Pomelo, we are committed to hiring the best team to improve outcomes for all mothers and babies, regardless of their background. We need diverse perspectives to reflect the diversity of problems we face and the population we serve. We look to hire people from a variety of backgrounds, including but not limited to race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status.

Potential Fraud Warning


Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud. With the increase of remote work and digital hiring, phishing and job scams are on the rise with malicious actors impersonating real employees and sending fake job offers in an effort to collect personal or financial information.

Pomelo Care will never ask you to pay a fee or download software as part of the interview process with our company. Pomelo Care will also never ask for your personal banking or other financial information until after you have signed an offer of employment and completed onboarding paperwork that is provided by our People Operations team. All official communication with Pomelo Care People Operations team will come from domain email addresses ending in @pomelocare.com.

If you receive a message that seems suspicious, we encourage you to pause communication and contact us directly at to confirm its legitimacy. For your safety, we also recommend applying only through our official Careers page. jobs.description:
Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future.
Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. The people who shape our company come from other backgrounds, including concert music performances, humanitarian aid, opera singing, sports writing, and BMX racing. You will be part of a team that loves to succeed together.
In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more.

Your Team

We are seeking a skilled Database Administrator (DBA) to help manage and support our database systems as a core part of our infrastructure team.
You will take ownership of the day-to-day operations, availability, backups and performance of production and development database environments, while also contributing to automation, tuning, and modernization efforts.
This role involves working closely with systems infrastructure and storage components, and will require hands-on management of both software and the underlying hardware that supports the database environment.
This is a hands-on role for someone with strong expertise in at least one major relational database (PostgreSQL), preferably with additional experience with one or more of (MySQL, Oracle or SQLserver) and a desire to grow into broader technical domains.

Responsibilities

  • Administer, monitor, and maintain relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle) in production and development environments
  • Perform routine DB operations such as backup and recovery, schema changes, patching, upgrades, and security hardening
  • Support incident response, root cause analysis, and recovery for database-related issues
  • Automation, configuration management, modernization
  • Monitoring and analysis
  • Work collaboratively with systems and infrastructure teams to understand storage, OS, and networking components that influence database performance and reliability
  • Leverage basic Linux command-line and systems knowledge to troubleshoot and improve DB processes

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with at least one of PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle (PostgreSQL strongly preferred)
  • Solid grasp of daily DBA operational tasks, including backups, replication, security, user management, and logging
  • At minimum, basic experience with performance tuning; medium level strongly preferred
  • Basic knowledge of Linux systems, including filesystem layout, memory/disk utilization, and OS-level tools
  • Experience with configuration management (Ansible) and other automation/deployment tools
  • Experience with both On-Prem and Cloud configuration
  • Experience with database specific Monitoring

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to containerized environments (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes) for running database workloads
  • Familiarity with Ceph RBD as a backend for database storage or similar distributed storage systems
  • Understanding of modern big data formats or engines like Hadoop, Parquet, RocksDB
  • Linux networking fundamentals (troubleshooting connections, ports, interfaces)
  • Experience with cloud-based DB offerings (e.g., AWS RDS, Azure Database, GCP Cloud SQL)
  • Familiarity with application development or scripting in BASH, Java or Python, particularly for automating databases install/configuration
  • Experience with general Monitoring and Alerting

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $155,000 to $195,000 in the location(s) of this posting. Individual salaries are determined through a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography. Base salary does not include other forms of total compensation such as bonus compensation and other benefits. Our benefits package includes medical, dental and vision coverage, life and AD&D insurance, 20 days of paid time off, 9 sick days, and a 401(k) plan with a company match.

For more details regarding eligibility, terms and conditions please make sure to review the Voleon Referral Bonus Program.

Job Description

Immigration Consultant

Contract:Full-time

Team:Nomadic

Location: Istanbul, Turkey (Remote)

Consultants are responsible for assisting Senior Consultants, Supervisors and Managers with the successful delivery of the team’s output of work, reporting in most cases to the Senior Consultant or Supervisor responsible for the team. This includes the preparation and drafting of applications, monitoring workflows and ensuring the CRM is updated and day-to-day liaison with clients. The Consultant will work independently on cases but will also be expected to share knowledge and expertise with other members of the team and to take a keen interest in developing their own knowledge and experience.

What your day will look like:

  • Manage a centralised mailbox receiving client queries and responding or redirecting to the relevant parties

  • Ensure that all Service Level Agreement standards are met or exceeded
  • Update and maintain applications within our technology platforms, ensuring all applications are processed within the required SLAs

  • Provide accurate information to clients upon their visa request, with support

Nomadic is an online knowledge-driven technology solution that simplifies complex global business travel and short-term visa processes. By combining the unmatched legal knowledge of Fragomen, the world’s leading provider of immigration services, with dynamic digital data collection, Nomadic’s unique automated pre-trip compliance assessment delivers accurate results for travellers, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements, including immigration, social security and tax.

Our global teams operate in a fast-paced, forward-thinking environment, providing exceptional client service, tailored guidance, and logistical support with consular filing in multiple jurisdictions.

Essential criteria:

  • Previous Schengen visa processing experience
  • Strong background in a client facing role

  • Develop strong working relationships with team members and gain their confidence through displaying professionalism and efficiency in all communications

If you require any specific accommodations or support during the interview process, please let us know, and we will consider what reasonable adjustments are possible to meet your needs

Who we are:

At Fragomen, we are more than a global immigration services provider – we are pioneers shaping the future of mobility. With a passion for navigating the complexities of immigration, we help individuals and businesses transcend borders, unlocking opportunities around the world. As a forward-thinking, global business, we combine deep expertise with innovative technology to craft solutions that not only simplify the immigration process but also drive strategic success for our clients. Whether it is assisting multinational companies or helping people start new chapters in their lives, we are driven by the belief that global movement is the key to unlocking a world of possibilities.

We are proud of our team spirit, and we like to reflect this in the way that we work and everything we do. Our Responsible Business Practices ("RBP") prioritize Fragomen's social responsibility through a cohesive strategy covering five key focus areas: Corporate Social Responsibility, Culture and Inclusion, Sustainability, Well-Being and Pro Bono. Our RBP initiatives offer great opportunities for everyone at Fragomen to feel included, get involved and shape thoughtful initiatives and activities. Meillä Enersensellä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten ja mielenkiintoisten työtehtävien parissa rennossa ja kannustavassa työympäristössä. Tarjoamme sinulle haasteita ja vastuuta, sillä uskomme, että juuri se tekee työnteosta mukavaa ja kehittävää.

Avoinna oleva tehtävä sijoittuu Power-liiketoimintayksikköön, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme toteuttamaan energiamurrosta energiasektorin koko elinkaaren kattavilla palveluilla. Suunnittelemme ja rakennamme voimansiirtoverkkoja, sähköasemia sekä akkuvarastoja. Tarjoamme myös energiasektorin kunnossapitopalveluita.

Pääasialliset työtehtävät:

  • Voimajohtojen 110 kV – 400 kV suunnittelu- ja asiantuntijatehtävät
  • Yksikön sisäinen yhteistyö ja toimeksiannot
  • Osaamisesta ja kehittymisestä riippuen työnkuvasi voi sisältää erilaisia sähkösuunnittelu-, rakennesuunnittelu-, paikkatieto- ja lunastustehtäviä

Vaatimukset:

  • Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. sähkötekniikka, maanmittausala, rakennustekniikka tai muu tekninen koulutus)
  • Aiempi kokemus infrastruktuuri-, sähköverkko- tai voimajohtohankkeiden suunnittelusta tai vahva kiinnostus kehittyä niiden parissa
  • Kokemus esim. sijoitussuunnittelusta katsotaan eduksi
  • Kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti ja osana projektitiimiä
  • Hyvät IT-taidot ja valmius oppia suunnitteluohjelmia
  • Halu kehittää omaa osaamista ja suunnittelutehtäviä
  • Sujuva suomen kielen taito sekä hyvä englannin kielen osaaminen, ruotsin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Mahdollisuuden työskennellä energia-alan merkittävimpien hankkeiden parissa
  • Asiantuntevan ja kannustavan työyhteisön
  • Monipuoliset kehittymis- ja uramahdollisuudet
  • Joustavat työskentelytavat sekä etätyömahdollisuuden

Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia? Tiedämme, että jotkut ihmiset hakevat vähemmän todennäköisesti työpaikkoja, elleivät he täytä jokaista haluttua vaatimusta. Me Enersensellä olemme omistautuneet rakentamaan monipuolisen, osallistavan ja autenttisen työpaikan, joten jos olet innoissasi tästä roolista, mutta aiempi kokemuksesi ei vastaa täysin kaikkia työnkuvauksen pätevyyksiä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan paikkaa joka tapauksessa!

Otatko haasteen vastaan? Hae meille työhön, jossa pääset kehittymään työskentelemällä mukavien ja haastavien työtehtävien parissa osana tsemppaavaa työyhteisöä!

Hakuaika päättyy 11.10.2026. Lähetäthän hakemuksesi kuitenkin pian, sillä etenemme haastatteluissa mahdollisesti jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Jonna Katavisto, Talent Acquisition Partner, +358 44 360 6783, . Soittoajat ti 22.9. klo 14-15 ja ti 1.10. klo 11-12.

Job Summary

The National Partner Manager serves as Westfield's primary relationship leader for our largest and most strategically important national distribution partners, including agency networks, aggregators, financial institutions, and private equity-backed organizations with complex agency structures. This highly visible role is responsible for developing executive-level partnerships, aligning enterprise and partner strategies, and driving profitable growth across Westfield's Standard Lines business segments.

Working closely with senior leaders across Distribution Management, Underwriting, Product, Operations, and other enabling functions, the National Partner Manager influences strategic direction, identifies emerging market opportunities, and provides leadership across some of Westfield's most significant distribution relationships. The role serves as the strategic owner of the partner lifecycle, providing executive engagement, growth planning, governance oversight, performance stewardship, and issue resolution across corporate, regional, and local stakeholder groups.

Through business development, market intelligence, and cross-functional leadership, the National Partner Manager helps ensure alignment between Westfield's business strategies and partner objectives while creating long-term value for both organizations. This role plays a critical part in shaping how Westfield competes, grows, and strengthens relationships with some of the most influential organizations in the insurance distribution marketplace.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead and strengthen executive-level relationships with a portfolio of Westfield's most strategic national distribution partners, including agency networks, aggregators, financial institutions, and private equity-backed organizations.
  • Develop and execute partner growth strategies that align partner objectives with Westfield's business priorities and profitable growth goals.
  • Serve as the strategic owner of assigned partnerships, providing leadership across executive engagement, performance stewardship, governance, and relationship lifecycle management.
  • Identify, influence, and capitalize on opportunities to expand business, increase market presence, and strengthen long-term partner value.
  • Lead strategic business planning and performance reviews, utilizing data and market insights to drive results across business segments and optimize partner performance.
  • Collaborate with leaders across Distribution Management, Underwriting, Product, Operations, and other business functions to ensure enterprise alignment and a coordinated partner experience.
  • Provide market intelligence and strategic insights regarding distribution trends, agency consolidation, private equity activity, and emerging opportunities within the insurance marketplace.
  • Facilitate governance and accountability processes that support effective partnership management, risk oversight, and compliance with company standards.
  • Represent Westfield as a trusted advisor, influencing strategic decisions and strengthening relationships with senior leaders across partner organizations.
  • Manage budgets and partnership investments responsibly while ensuring alignment with business objectives.

jobs.title: SVP, Email Product Area
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SINCH Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SINCH

Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world. More than 200,000 businesses rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email. Whether customers need to verify users, deliver critical notifications, or build rich omnichannel engagement, Sinch makes it easy to connect reliably and securely at every step of the customer journey.

At Sinch we Dream Big, Win Together, Keepit Simple, and Make it Happen. These values are our foundation.

DESCRIPTION

Sinch Mailgun is one of the most important product areas within Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud. Mailgun helps businesses send, validate, test, optimize, and analyze email at scale through an API-first platform built for developers, marketers, platforms, and enterprise senders.

We are looking for an SVP of Email to lead Mailgun end-to-end as a senior product and engineering leader with clear business accountability. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, team health, and commercial outcomes for Mailgun, working closely with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, operations, security, compliance, and regional teams to accelerate growth, improve customer experience, and establish Mailgun as Sinch’s standard for enterprise-grade email. A core part of the mandate will be to build and drive the plan to bring Email into Sinch Build as a Sinch Email offering powered by Mailgun, making email easier to discover, adopt, integrate, and expand as part of Sinch’s broader developer and customer communications platform.

The Mandate

This role has a clear mandate: make Mailgun the center of Sinch’s Email strategy, scale it as a durable growth business, and bring Email into Sinch Build as a first-class product experience. The SVP of Email will need to simplify the portfolio, sharpen the product and platform strategy, improve the customer journey, drive stronger commercial outcomes, and build the operating discipline required for enterprise-grade scale.

What you’ll do

  • Set the Email strategy and operating model. Own the vision, strategy, priorities, investment choices, and operating rhythm for Mailgun across Send, Optimize, Validate, Inspect, related platform capabilities, and the Email on Acid transition.

  • Lead product, engineering, and platform execution. Build and develop high-performing teams with clear ownership, strong execution discipline, technical excellence, and a culture of customer focus. Balance growth, platform modernization, reliability, security, scalability, technical debt, and delivery predictability.

  • Bring Email into Sinch Build. Build and execute the product, technical, commercial, and go-to-market plan to make Sinch Email, powered by Mailgun, a first-class offering in Sinch Build for developers, platforms, and enterprise customers.

  • Drive growth and commercial performance. Own the product area’s performance across revenue growth, gross profit, margin, pricing and packaging, product-led growth, customer adoption, retention, expansion, and enterprise growth. Use data to understand funnel performance and make clear trade-offs across self-service, sales-assisted, partner, and enterprise motions.

  • Strengthen Mailgun’s market position. Define how Mailgun wins as an API-first email platform for reliable delivery, validation, quality assurance, deliverability intelligence, observability, and optimization at scale.

  • Simplify and unify the customer experience. Create a more cohesive experience across sending, deliverability, testing, analytics, onboarding, account management, billing, support, and cross-product workflows. Make it easier for customers to discover, buy, onboard, use, expand, and integrate Mailgun.

  • Partner deeply with go-to-market teams. Work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, partnerships, finance, operations, and regional teams to sharpen positioning, improve conversion, strengthen pipeline contribution, support strategic accounts, and improve expansion and retention.

  • Build for enterprise scale, trust, and compliance. Ensure Mailgun has the architecture, security, reliability, data governance, compliance, deliverability operations, and operational discipline required for global enterprise customers and high-volume senders.

  • Expand the ecosystem. Build growth through developer channels, MarTech integrations, marketplaces, embedded product motions, strategic partnerships, and native integration with broader Sinch experiences.

  • Use data to run the business. Establish and manage clear operating metrics across acquisition, activation, conversion, usage, deliverability, retention, expansion, customer satisfaction, reliability, cost, and unit economics.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 12–15+ years across product management, engineering leadership, and business leadership, with meaningful time in senior executive roles.

  • Experience leading both product and engineering teams, with accountability for full product delivery from strategy through execution, operations, and product performance.

  • A track record scaling SaaS, API-first, developer platform, or communications products across self-service, product-led growth, enterprise sales, and partner-led motions.

  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience with P&L ownership, pricing and packaging, gross margin improvement, portfolio investment decisions, and resource trade-offs.

  • Deep customer orientation and strong instincts for developer experience, onboarding, activation, deliverability, reliability, retention, and expansion.

  • Experience operating in complex, global, cross-functional environments with distributed teams and multiple regional go-to-market motions.

  • Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to align senior stakeholders, represent Sinch with strategic customers and partners, and make complex trade-offs clear.

  • Proven ability to lead through change while maintaining urgency, clarity, accountability, and team health.

Nice to have, but not required:

  • Background in email infrastructure, deliverability, email marketing, CPaaS, customer engagement, developer platforms, MarTech, or adjacent SaaS markets.

  • Experience leading branded portfolios through integration, modernization, consolidation, or migration.

jobs.description:
Want to lead the technical design behind modernizing AccuWeather For Business — the platform that delivers AccuWeather’s data and services to more than half of the Fortune 500? We are looking for a Data Architect I who combines strong platform design expertise with the judgment to assess legacy infrastructure and design an implementable, cloud-native architecture; someone who wants to own the technical direction of a critical modernization initiative without compromising the reliability enterprise clients depend on. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this position will assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business and design the cloud-native architecture that will support its future. You will produce architecture and modernization design documents — including current-state assessments, target-state designs, transition and sequencing plans, and technical specifications — and work alongside engineering teams to implement key components of the architecture, while maintaining the reliability of the backend data systems that support critical data delivery services.

You will demonstrate high-level knowledge across cloud platforms and legacy enterprise systems, independently resolve complex architecture and modernization challenges, and collaborate closely with the Data Architect II and engineering teams. Your work will help modernize the technology foundation behind AccuWeather For Business, creating a more scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platform while maintaining the reliability expected by the Fortune 500 companies that depend on it.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business, documenting current-state architecture, system dependencies, data flows, and technical debt to inform modernization priorities.
  • Design the cloud-native architecture, producing architecture designs, technical specifications, and other documentation needed to guide implementation.
  • Own the architectural direction for the modernization effort, ensuring a cohesive approach across the platform rather than individual services or components.
  • Develop a roadmap and sequencing plan that provides a practical path from the current environment to the cloud-native architecture while minimizing disruption to enterprise clients.
  • Design backend data systems to maintain continuity of critical data delivery services throughout the transition.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to validate and implement architecture designs, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, performant, and maintainable.
  • Contribute hands-on to the implementation of architecture designs, including developing and modifying code, data models, schemas, and supporting data platform components.
  • Estimate data consumption, capacity, and infrastructure requirements, incorporating cloud infrastructure costs into architecture decisions and trade-offs.
  • Identify and document architectural and operational risks associated with modernizing a customer-facing production platform, and design appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure the cloud-native architecture addresses performance, security, scalability, resiliency, recoverability, compliance, and data residency requirements.
  • Understand system scheduling, integrations, and dependencies across the platform and incorporate them into planning and sequencing.
  • Serve as a technical point of contact for questions and decisions related to the modernization effort’s architectural direction.

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data or enterprise architecture, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o High-level knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and cloud-native architecture.

o Demonstrated experience assessing legacy, on-premises systems and designing modern, cloud-native architectures.

o Demonstrated experience planning or supporting large-scale modernization initiatives for production, customer-facing platforms.

o Experience designing production data platforms for performance, scalability, resiliency, and recoverability.

o Experience analyzing complex system dependencies, integrations, data flows, and scheduling requirements to inform architecture and modernization decisions.

o Demonstrated experience working with PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, schema design, and query development.

o Advanced proficiency in Python or Go, with experience developing production-quality code for data platforms or backend systems.

· Preferred Qualifications:

o Experience designing backend data platforms that support data delivery to external or enterprise clients.

o Experience evaluating technology and architecture options, including build-versus-buy decisions and alternative modernization approaches.

o Experience evaluating infrastructure requirements and costs to inform cloud architecture decisions and design trade-offs.

o Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and data governance requirements, including SOC 2 and data residency considerations.

· Skills & Competencies:

o Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design architectures that engineering teams can implement and maintain effectively.

o Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce clear, actionable architecture and technical design documentation.

o Sound technical judgment, with the ability to translate business and platform requirements into pragmatic architecture without overengineering or underspecifying solutions.

o Ability to move effectively between architecture and hands-on implementation, translating designs into working solutions in collaboration with engineering teams.

o Ability to mentor team members and help develop the architectural judgment of less experienced engineers.

o Ability to independently lead complex, large-scale architecture initiatives and drive technical decisions through ambiguity.

About AccuWeather

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs.

Are you passionate about dairy science and interested in using data to improve herd performance, animal health, and farm decision-making?

VAS, a URUS Group company, is looking for a Dairy Data Scientist who brings strong knowledge of dairy production and the ability to apply statistics, analytics, and programming to real-world dairy challenges.

This role sits at the intersection of dairy science, research, analytics, and technology. You’ll work with veterinarians, nutritionists, dairy scientists, farm operators, data engineers, and software teams to analyze biological, production, sensor, and operational data and turn it into meaningful insights for the dairy industry.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze dairy production, herd health, nutrition, reproduction, sensor, genomic, and operational data.

  • Apply statistical analysis and predictive modeling to identify trends, risks, and opportunities related to herd performance.

  • Support dairy research initiatives, field trials, experimental design, data analysis, and technical reporting.

  • Use tools such as Python, R, SQL, Databricks, or similar analytics platforms to explore and analyze complex datasets.

  • Help develop dashboards, reports, decision-support tools, and automated analytics.

  • Evaluate precision dairy technologies, herd-management systems, automated milking systems, IoT devices, and other emerging technologies.

  • Partner with veterinarians, nutritionists, farm managers, researchers, data scientists, and engineers.

  • Translate scientific findings and analytical results into practical recommendations for dairy operations and business teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Dairy Science, Animal Science, Agricultural Science, Statistics, Data Science, Veterinary Science, Biology, or a related field.

  • Meaningful academic, research, or professional experience related to dairy cattle, dairy production, herd health, nutrition, reproduction, milk production, or animal science.

  • Experience using data and statistics to answer scientific or operational questions.

  • Some hands-on programming or analytics experience with tools such as Python, R, SQL, SAS, or similar technologies.

  • Knowledge of statistical analysis, experimental design, or predictive modeling.

  • Ability to communicate scientific and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new data platforms and technologies.

Even Better If You Bring

  • Master’s or PhD with research focused on dairy production, animal science, nutrition, reproduction, genetics, or animal health.

  • Experience working with dairy herd-management, DHIA, sensor, genomic, or precision dairy data.

  • Experience with Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, or cloud-based analytics platforms.

  • Experience with machine learning or predictive modeling.

  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other visualization tools.

  • Peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or technical research reports.

  • Direct exposure to dairy farm operations and an understanding of how scientific recommendations translate into day-to-day farm decisions.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to combine dairy science with modern analytics and help solve meaningful problems affecting herd health, production efficiency, sustainability, and farm profitability.

You don’t need to arrive as an expert in every technology we use. If you bring strong dairy knowledge, scientific curiosity, quantitative skills, and some coding experience, we want to hear from you.

Website | X/Twitter | LinkedIn

About Securitize Capital

Securitize Capital is a registered investment adviser and investment manager focused on bringing traditional investment products on-chain through tokenization.

Securitize Capital currently serves as investment manager to eight investment funds spanning private equity, private credit, CLOs, high-yield credit and other alternative investment strategies. Our funds combine traditional investment management and fund infrastructure with blockchain-based ownership and transaction capabilities, providing a unique opportunity to help build the operational framework for the next generation of investment products.

We are seeking an Associate, Fund Operations to support the day-to-day operations of Securitize Capital's investment funds and help build scalable operational processes as the platform continues to grow.

What You'll Do

The Associate will work closely with the Securitize Capital team and a broad group of internal and external partners, including fund administrators, auditors, tax providers, custodians, transfer agents, sub-advisers and other service providers.

Responsibilities will include:

Fund Operations & Financial Oversight

  • Review daily, monthly and quarterly fund financials, NAV calculations and supporting reports prepared by fund administrators.
  • Review fund-level activity, including subscriptions, redemptions, investment activity, cash movements, expenses, management fees and expense accruals.
  • Assist with cash and liquidity management across the funds.
  • Help identify and resolve NAV, accounting, reconciliation and operational discrepancies.

Fund Accounting, Audit & Tax

  • Coordinate with third-party fund administrators on accounting and financial reporting matters.
  • Support annual fund audits, including coordinating information and responding to requests from auditors.
  • Coordinate with tax preparers on annual tax filings, investor tax reporting and related information requests.
  • Assist with the review of audited financial statements and other periodic fund reporting.
  • Maintain organized records and supporting documentation for fund expenses, invoices, accruals and other financial activity.

Service Provider & Internal Coordination

  • Serve as an operational point of contact for fund administrators, auditors, tax providers, custodians, sub-advisers and other third-party service providers.
  • Coordinate across Securitize Capital and affiliated teams, including fund administration and transfer agency functions.
  • Track open operational items and ensure issues are appropriately escalated and resolved.

Tokenized Fund Operations

  • Develop an understanding of how blockchain-based fund interests interact with traditional fund accounting, custody and transfer agency infrastructure.
  • Support operational workflows involving digital assets and stablecoins, including subscription and redemption activity where applicable.

What We're Looking For

  • Approximately 2–5 years of experience in fund operations, fund accounting, asset management, fund administration, audit or a related financial-services role.
  • Experience reviewing private fund financial statements, NAVs, capital activity or fund accounting records.
  • Strong understanding of basic investment fund accounting concepts, including NAV, subscriptions and redemptions, management fees, fund expenses, accruals and cash reconciliation.
  • Strong attention to detail and an ability to independently investigate discrepancies.
  • Comfortable working in an environment where processes are still being built and standardized.
  • Strong Excel skills and an ability to work effectively with financial and operational data.

Helpful Experience

Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • Private investment funds, including private equity, private credit, hedge funds or other alternative investment vehicles.
  • Fund administration or fund accounting.
  • Investment advisers or registered investment advisers.
  • Digital assets, blockchain technology, tokenized securities or stablecoins.
  • Alternative investments such as private credit, CLOs, high-yield bonds or private equity.

Prior digital asset experience is helpful but not required. We are primarily looking for someone with strong fund-operations fundamentals who is interested in learning how traditional investment fund infrastructure can operate using blockchain technology.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys understanding how a fund works from end to end rather than focusing on only one part of the accounting or operational process.

You should be comfortable moving between detailed financial review and broader operational problem-solving. Whether that means reviewing a NAV, investigating a reconciliation difference, coordinating an audit request, documenting a new procedure or helping determine how a new tokenized fund workflow should operate.

Because Securitize Capital operates at the intersection of traditional asset management and digital assets, this role is particularly well suited for someone who has a strong foundation in traditional fund operations and is interested in helping build the operational infrastructure for tokenized investment products.

We're looking for someone who has built highly performant OLTP systems, who fully understands the importance and impact of efficient MySQL at scale, and who knows how to identify and focus on the areas that will have the most impact. You should be a Rails wizard who understands all the subtleties of generating performant MySQL using ActiveRecord. You should have a passion for database efficiency!

Responsibilities

  • Work hands-on to identify, analyze, and resolve slow ActiveRecord queries across the Rails monolith
  • Optimize query performance through indexing, query rewriting, and schema improvements
  • Collaborate with DBAs and other technical teams to diagnose and remediate database bottlenecks
  • Validate all performance improvements through testing, and performance measurement at high load
  • Use Datadog to analyze query performance and identify high-impact optimization opportunities
  • Implement selective caching in Redis where appropriate to reduce database load
  • Document findings and share best practices for performant query design
  • Contribute to long-term performance and scalability efforts across MySQL, TiDB, Elasticache, and Opensearch
  • Deep expertise with Ruby on Rails, able to craft elegant and minimal solutions to complex problems
  • Deep expertise with ActiveRecord MySQL query optimization — must go way beyond standard ActiveRecord use
  • Strong understanding of SQL execution and query optimization at the engine level
  • 6–10+ years of professional experience (senior level)
  • Proven ability to read, understand, and improve complex application code across large systems
  • Experience tuning queries, adding indexes, and interpreting execution plans
  • Comfortable partnering with DBAs and other technical teams to debug and resolve performance issues
  • Clear communicator who’s unafraid to ask questions or seek domain input when needed
  • Bachelor’s degree (BA or BS) or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with alternative database technologies such as TiDB, Elasticache, Opensearch, or DynamoDB

  • Experience with query analysis and performance tooling (e.g., Datadog, Looker, K6)

Success in this role requires thoughtful account planning, technical fluency, and the ability to guide customers through sophisticated evaluation and purchasing processes. You will manage complex sales cycles, expand instrument placements, increase ongoing consumables usage, and build long-term customer value in partnership with Oxford Nanopore’s applications, inside sales, clinical sales, and marketing teams.

This is a remote, field-based position. Candidates must reside in the Silicon Valley Area and be able to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.

  • Collaborate across functions
    Coordinate territory activities with Inside Sales, Field Applications, Clinical Sales, and Marketing colleagues to deliver consistent, high-quality customer engagement.
  • Manage pipeline and forecasting
    Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline using consultative selling methodologies. Provide accurate forecasts and maintain timely CRM updates, funnel reporting, and competitive intelligence.
  • Deliver commercial results
    Pursue growth opportunities with urgency, discipline, and resilience. Work toward clearly defined performance objectives and navigate competitive sales situations with preparation, insight, and persistence.
  • Represent Oxford Nanopore in the market
    Participate in regional seminars, workshops, conferences, and other customer-facing events to strengthen Oxford Nanopore’s visibility and scientific credibility.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Vice President, Global Therapeutic Area Leader, Oncology Job Location: Remote United States Job Location Type: Remote Job Contract Type: Full-time Job Seniority Level: The Vice President, Therapeutic Area Leader provides global scientific, strategic, and operational leadership within an assigned Therapeutic Area within the Global Therapeutic Area Expertise & Delivery organisation.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Vice President, Global Therapeutic Area Leader, Oncology

Job Location: Remote United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

The Vice President, Therapeutic Area Leader provides global scientific, strategic, and operational leadership within an assigned Therapeutic Area within the Global Therapeutic Area Expertise & Delivery organisation. This role shapes and executes the global medical strategy within the assigned Therapeutic Area in alignment with enterprise objectives and under the direction of the Global Therapeutic Area Head. The role upholds scientific quality and compliant, risk‑based decision‑making, and leads consistent, high‑quality delivery of therapeutic area activities across clients, regions, and delivery models.

The position serves as a senior scientific partner to clients and supports enterprise and TA leadership in external scientific engagement, representing Fortrea as a delegated and credible TA thought leader. Success is demonstrated through strong, people leadership, execution and governance, high‑performing TA medical leadership, trusted client relationships, and measurable delivery and growth outcomes within the assigned Therapeutic Area scope.


Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the definition of and lead execution of the global Therapeutic Area strategy, aligned to enterprise objectives and client needs.
  • Translate TA science, regulatory trends, and market dynamics into scalable medical service offerings and execution roadmaps.
  • Provide TA‑specific insights, analysis, and recommendations to support enterprise decision‑making related to investment priorities, operating model evolution, and growth strategy.
  • Serve as a senior scientific partner to clients, participating in senior client interactions and governance forums and engaging with executive stakeholders (e.g., CMO, VP Global Therapeutic Area Expertise & Delivery / Global Therapeutic Area Head, Safety, Data Management, Regulatory, Operations, Project Management and Commercial) to shape strategy and outcomes within assigned programs and accounts.
  • Lead or participate in scientific governance forums and provide medical oversight for complex or high‑risk TA activities within assigned scope.
  • Serve as a final escalation point for complex medical, scientific, ethical, and regulatory decisions, recommending risk‑appropriate actions and escalating as appropriate to the Global Therapeutic Area Head or enterprise governance.
  • Ensure consistent application of established standards for scientific quality, compliance, and integrity, balancing innovation with patient safety and data integrity, and contribute to continuous improvement of process and governance.
  • Lead and mentor senior TA medical leaders within the assigned Therapeutic Area, ensuring leadership development, succession planning, and capability continuity.
  • Coach, partner with, and advise Regional Heads of the TA medical team to align regional execution to global TA strategy, strengthen leadership capability and collaboration, and drive consistent scientific quality and high performance across geographies in coordination with TA and enterprise leadership.
  • Support and lead, as appropriate, enterprise‑wide talent, culture, and organisational effectiveness initiatives (e.g., talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, and engagement).
  • Partner cross‑functionally with Clinical Operations, Regulatory, Commercial, Strategy, and Data teams to embed Therapeutic Area perspectives into delivery and growth initiatives.
  • Drive innovation in TA medical services, evidence generation approaches, and engagement models within assigned scope, including areas such as precision medicine, immuno‑oncology, real‑world evidence, and digital health and Advanced Therapeutics.
  • Represent Fortrea externally to strengthen the Company’s visibility and position within the contract research organization and broader medical/scientific environment through select strategic industry engagement and TA thought leadership, including publications, presentations, and panel participation at national and international scientific and industry meetings, as appropriate for the role and in alignment with enterprise positioning.
  • Support portfolio delivery through oversight of assigned programs, ensuring adherence to established quality and compliance requirements and proactively identifying and escalating risks.
  • Support service development and technical positioning within the Therapeutic Area, providing scientific and medical content for Client Engagement activities, proposals, bid defenses, and client solution development.
  • Provide clinical and scientific input to due diligence activities as a contributor, as required.
  • Own delivery excellence and scientific quality across assigned TA programs and clients, ensuring compliant, consistent execution across portfolio, aligned with global strategy.
  • Travel up to 2–3 trips per month (domestic and/or international), as required.
  • Perform other duties as needed or assigned.
  • Occasional travel to clients/site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • MD, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent advanced scientific degree. Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience and successful project outcomes in lieu of educational requirements.
  • Deep Therapeutic Area expert with specific, relevant experience in (Oncology, IIGM, RAPT, CVMER, Neuroscience & Ophthalmology fields, as appropriate/required), drug development and medical and scientific services, including global medical portfolio Governance and Delivery and applicable regulatory and compliance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated executive-level judgment and decision-making in complex, ambiguous environments.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop senior medical/scientific leaders and shape inclusive, high-performing teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills with the ability to influence at executive level.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Typically, 10+ years of progressive experience in one or more of the following medical fields: Oncology, IIGM, RAPT, CVMER, Neuroscience, and/or Ophthalmology - within pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, and/or related environments.
  • Senior leadership experience in Medical and Scientific Services and/or Clinical Development roles within regulated drug development environments, with accountability for strategy execution, medical governance, and high‑quality delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging senior client and external stakeholders and contributing to business growth through solution shaping, proposals and bid defenses, and/or program‑ or portfolio‑level development activities.
  • Proven ability to lead in global, matrixed organizations, providing oversight across regions and multi‑program portfolios, with strong strategic thinking and problem‑solving skills.
  • Deep knowledge of integrated global drug development, including quality, compliance, and risk‑based decision‑making frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Experience leading within a CRO and/or outsourced medical services model.
  • Track record of contributing to the build and scale of global Therapeutic Area capabilities, operating models, and governance practices.
  • Experience leading complex, matrixed, and geographically distributed medical/scientific organizations.
  • Scientific thought leadership evidenced by publications, presentations, and/or industry engagement (as appropriate).

Physical Demands / Work Environment:

Work Environment:

  • Work is performed in an office and/or home-based environment with exposure to electrical office equipment (namely standard office equipment and screen-based work).

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.
  • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
  • Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
  • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
  • Light to moderate lifting and carrying, or moving of objects, including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
  • Regular and consistent attendance.
  • Varied hours may be required.

For US Based Candidates:

Pay Range: USD $200,000-$450,000 / annually

Benefits: All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data. Regular, full-time or part-time employees working 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(K), Paid time off (PTO) or Flexible time off (FTO), Company bonus where applicable.
