jobs.excerpt: About UsWork a four-day week from anywhere for a company where people genuinely believe in what they do.
jobs.description:
About Us

Work a four-day week from anywhere for a company where people genuinely believe in what they do. Wonderlic leads the way in fair, predictive science to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job—and that starts with you. We expertly combine our science-based assessment expertise with I-O psychology, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to deliver evidence-based insights that empower smarter employment decisions. Our simple, intuitive assessment tools help sophisticated HR teams identify top applicants, predict on-the-job performance, and ensure our own team is engaged and equipped to do their best work.

Wonderlic has always championed progressive, sustainable approaches that allow people to excel professionally while living balanced, fulfilling lives.Here are some of the ways we do that: 

  • Work from anywhere in the United States 
  • Four-day work week
  • Generous PTO plus a paid company shutdown from 12/24 to 1/1
  • Benefits include medical, dental, vision, 401k with matching, paid new parent leave

What Sets Us Apart:

  • Scientific Precision: We apply rigorous scientific methodologies to develop assessments that accurately gauge individuals' potential and fit within various organizational contexts.
  • Innovation: Our dedication to continuous improvement drives us to explore cutting-edge techniques and technologies, ensuring our assessments remain at the forefront of talent assessment.
  • Impactful Solutions: By integrating I-O Psychology principles into our processes, we deliver solutions that not only meet the immediate hiring needs of organizations but also contribute to long-term success and retention.

Overview:

Wonderlic is seeking a Senior Research Scientist to sit at the precise intersection of I-O psychology and machine learning - someone who has spent time building real systems with real data who cares deeply about what those systems are predicting. This is not a role for an ML engineer who finds people data interesting as a side project, or for an I-O psychologist who has learned to code. We’re looking for someone who has genuinely lived in both worlds and is ready to own the problems that live between them.

Wonderlic built its applied AI/ML team from scratch, developed the Jobs Engine, a first-of-its-kind machine learning system for job analysis at scale, and won the 2025 SIOP Machine Learning Competition. We’re now refining and expanding that work to deliver sharper, richer job analysis insights across thousands of roles. You will own the continued improvement of our jobs engine, the system that ingests labor market data and produces job analysis at scale across thousands of roles, and serve as one of the organization’s experts on how AI should be applied to both employee selection and development.

Your Impact:

As Senior Research Scientist, you will set the scientific and technical direction for how Wonderlic understands work at scale and translates assessment science into AI-powered insight. Your work will directly determine the quality, defensibility, and reach of the inferences our platform makes about jobs and people - inferences that drive hiring decisions, development plans, and coaching conversations for millions of users. You will be the person in the organization who can hold both the I-O science question and the production ML question in the same breath, and answer both.

What You’ll Do

Lead the Continued Development of the Jobs Engine: Own the architecture, integrity, and continuous expansion of Wonderlic’s AI job analysis system, which ingests labor market data from O*NET, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other sources to extrapolate cognitive complexity ratings, norm groups, and occupational interest profiles for thousands of jobs. Build and refine the models that make inferences about work content from unstructured text. Leverage existing occupational taxonomies (e.g., O*NET, ESCO) where appropriate but also expand beyond them. Ensure all outputs are scientifically defensible and scalable as the nature of work evolves.

Act as an Expert on AI Implementation Across the Organization: Partner with product managers, engineers, and I-O psychologists to translate scientific requirements into AI-powered systems and ensure those systems meet the standards the work demands. Advise on which approaches are best suited to specific implementation challenges - assessment interpretation, manager and teams reporting, coaching content - and help teams understand what good looks like before they build and after they ship. Serve as an internal resource on what ML and AI can and cannot do in assessment and organizational contexts, and contribute to Wonderlic’s external scientific credibility.

Drive Scientific Rigor: Apply I-O psychology principles - adverse impact consideration, norm group construction, and evidence-based evaluation standards - to every system you build. Ensure that Wonderlic’s AI products meet professional and legal standards for selection and development tools. Push back when speed is being prioritized at the expense of defensibility, and find pragmatic paths forward when theoretical purity would prevent shipping.

What Success Looks Like: In your first six months, you will have a deep understanding of the jobs engine architecture and shipped at least one meaningful improvement to its coverage, accuracy, or scientific defensibility. You will have established working
relationships with the I-O and Product teams and have a clear roadmap for the continued integration of AI into the platform.

Within a year, you will have materially expanded the jobs engine’s reach and accuracy with demonstrable improvements to its coverage and the quality of inferences it produces. You will have contributed to the continued integration of AI across the platform, and be the person your colleagues go to with the hardest ML-meets-IO-science problems - not because you have every answer, but because you know how to find them.

The long-term marker of success is a jobs engine that provides defensible, scaled job analysis inference across millions of roles using a wide variety of inputs, AI capabilities integrated into the platform in ways that hold up to scientific and professional scrutiny, and a track record of using these technologies to improve people’s understanding of themselves, their work, and their teams. You will also have helped to develop new assessments that leverage emerging technologies which allow for richer and more secure evaluation of individuals.

What We’re Looking For:

Skills & Capabilities:

  • Applied NLP and ML engineering skills: embeddings, semantic search, clustering, text classification, transformer architectures, model tuning and evaluation, all on potentially messy, unstructured data
  • Occupational data modeling: job titles, task statements, skills, competencies, credentials, job families, seniority levels, title normalization, job similarity, role differentiation, and occupational frameworks such as O*NET and ESCO
  • Responsible AI judgment in employment contexts: fairness, explainability, auditability, bias mitigation, human review, and legal and ethical considerations in AI-supported selection and employee development systems
  • Generative AI evaluation skills: rubric-based review, groundedness checks, error analysis, regression testing, and evaluation of LLM-generated job descriptions, work-context summaries, and assessment result contextualization.
  • Product judgment for applied ML systems: balancing accuracy, explainability, automation, expert review, user input, maintainability, uncertainty, and job-specific nuance.
  • Working fluency with assessment and I/O concepts: job relatedness, criterion relationships, adverse impact, norm groups, assessment profiles, and score interpretation.
  • Ability to own ambiguous, high-complexity problems: framing underspecified problems, challenging weak assumptions, learning domain constraints quickly, and driving durable solutions in a small-company environment.

Mindset:

  • You came to I-O psychology because you care about work - what makes it meaningful, who thrives in it, how to measure fit. That hasn’t changed.
  • You have a healthy relationship with “good enough”: you know that perfect is the enemy of shipped, and you have the judgment to know where the line is.
  • You can hold both worlds simultaneously: what does this score mean for a real person, and how do I build the system that generates it.
  • You are genuinely curious about the problems that exist for both employee selection and development, not just tolerant of them.
  • You thrive in an environment that requires creativity and scrappiness: you can work comfortably in a situation where the problems are hard, the team is small, the constraints are many, and the ownership is real.

Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in I-O Psychology, Organizational Psychology, Organizational Development, or closely related field (quantitative focus strongly preferred); doctoral degree a plus
  • Demonstrated ML engineering experience with shipped, production-grade systems - not just research or coursework
  • Experience applying modern NLP methods to behavioral, assessment-based, or labor market data
  • Track record of work that had to be both technically sound and legally/professionally defensible
  • Minimum 3 years of applied industry experience; 5+ years preferred
  • Experience at the intersection of I-O science and algorithmic fairness strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with occupational taxonomies, vocational interests, or cognitive ability frameworks a significant plus

Compensation:

  • $130,000 to $150,000 based on experience and expertise.

Our Policy

  • Oversee the broker-dealer's accounting records, financial reporting, and general ledger processes.
  • Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
  • Analyze financial performance, capital adequacy, and operational metrics.
  • Provide financial guidance and recommendations to senior leadership.

  • Develop, implement, and maintain effective internal controls and supervisory procedures.

  • Oversee operational processes supporting broker-dealer activities.

  • Active participation in code reviews, learning and spreading technical knowledge

  • Evaluate and identify opportunities for new initiatives to support organizational needs
  • Create/maintain standard operational procedures

  • Sense of curiosity, resourcefulness, pragmatism
  • Production experience with incident response, on-call rotations
  • Strong working knowledge and understanding of cloud networking, traffic management (CNI, Istio)

  • Collaborative and adaptable mindset
  • Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
  • Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security
  • Excellent problem-solving skills – you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the possible solutions

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • Experience with distributed monitoring
  • Experience with data engineering
  • Startup experience
  • Open source experience
  • User of Bitwarden
  • Prior SaaS experience

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Meeting with our Recruiting team
  • Interview with SRE Manager
  • Interview(s) with SRE team panel
  • Interview with Head of Security

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.

In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

jobs.description:
Wizcorpでは、様々なコンソールやプラットフォーム向けのマルチプレイヤーゲーム開発に携わるテクニカルアーティストを募集しています。あなたのこれまでのご経歴、スキル、経験に応じて、当社のチーム内で最適なポジションをご紹介させていただきます。

全世界21カ国に拠点を持つ当社グループ会社のアーティストとしてワールドワイドで活躍するチャンスです。　世界各国の様々なスタイルのアートにふれあい、制作に携わる事であなた自身の経験と技術はより一層豊になるでしょう。

役割と責任 🎮📆🕹

ゲーム開発におけるアート制作の技術的サポートを担当していただきます。

  • グラフィック品質を向上させるための技術開発

  • グラフィックスを改善するための技術的ソリューションの提案と実装

  • アーティスト(デザイナー)の作業効率を向上させる技術の提案と実装

⭐経験 ⭐

  • 日本在住の候補者の場合: ゲーム開発に限らず、プログラミング、アート、ツール開発の分野での実務経験3年以上、豊富な技術経験をお持ちの方

  • 海外在住の候補者の場合: ゲーム開発に限らず、プログラミング、アート、ツール開発の分野での実務経験7年以上、豊富な技術経験をお持ちの方

  • C++とC#での経験

  • アセット/VFX最適化の経験

  • Unreal Engineおよび/またはカスタムエンジンなどのゲームミドルウェアでスクリプトを使用したグラフィック制作に関する業務経験

  • DCCスクリプトを使用したアート制作の経験、またはアート制作の効率化を行った経験をお持ちの方

  • 日常会話レベル以上の日本語能力 - JLPT N3以上

  • 英語能力(技術的な事項について読み、書き、議論できるレベル)

👍 歓迎条件 👍

  • Houdini上でVEXまたはPythonを使用したアート制作の経験、またはアート制作を効率化した経験をお持ちの方

選考の流れ🈸⚙️😊

① 書類選考: すべての応募者の履歴書を2週間以内に審査します。プロフィールが要件に合致する場合、その結果に基づいて、初回面接の日程をご連絡いたします。

② 面接: お人柄、情熱、スキル、そして私たちの仕事への関心を評価するため、3回の面接を実施します。また、私たちのビジョンや価値観を共有する時間も大切にしています。私たちがあなたを面接するのと同じように、あなたも私たちを面接していると考えているからです。

③ リファレンスチェック: あなたの経験や働き方をより深く理解するため、前職の雇用主または専門的な関係者にリファレンスチェックを実施します。

④ 内定: 最終面接後、2週間以内に最終決定を行い、採用となった場合は詳細な内定通知をお送りします。

入社プロセス 🈴🗼🌅

入社プロセスをできる限りスムーズで心配のないものにするよう努めています。

内定承諾後、労働契約書と就業規則をお送りします。

理想的には1ヶ月以内にご入社いただきたいと考えていますが、現在の就業状況に応じて調整可能です。

初日には、マネージャーがチームメンバーを紹介し、6ヶ月の試用期間中のレビュースケジュールを設定します。試用期間を無事に完了できるよう、必要なサポートをすべて提供します。

Wizcorpでは、共に成長します。

シニアスタッフがサポートとメンターシップを提供します。デジタル学習教材へのアクセスも可能で、マネージャーがキャリア目標に基づいたトレーニングカリキュラムの策定を支援します。

当社のキャリア理念については、こちらをご覧ください:

待遇・福利厚生

📍 勤務地と時間 📍

⏲ フレックスタイム制

クリエイティブな時間の使い方は人それぞれで異なり、自分に合う使い方はご自身が一番ご存じでしょう。

月曜日から金曜日の間で、コアタイムを11:00から16:00とし、一日あたり8時間仕事をしていただきます（1時間の休憩時間を除く）。コアタイム以外の時間配分はお任せいたします。

🌎 働く場所もフレキシブルです

Wizcorpではフルリモートワークを実施しており、ほとんどの社員が自宅で仕事をしています。もちろん必要に応じてオフィスで仕事することも可能で、会議室やフリーアドレスのデスクを使用していただけます。

オフィス所在地：〒168-0063 東京都杉並区和泉1-22-19 朝日生命代田橋ビル8～9階 (

Wizcorpでの勤務にあたり、日本国内に居住していただく必要があります。弊社で就労ビザの取得に関するサポートもさせていただきます。なお状況に応じ、試用期間内に限り、日本国外での勤務を許可する場合があります。

👷 雇用形態 👷‍

正社員

💴 給与 💴

本ポジションには以下の給与レンジを適用しています:

  • TA1: 月給400〜450万円(2〜3年相当の経験)

  • TA2: 月給450〜550万円(4〜5年相当の経験)

  • TA3: 月給550〜600万円(6〜7年相当の経験)

すべての新入社員の初任給は、経験と面接評価に基づいて決定されます。

6ヶ月の試用期間が含まれます。試用期間中も給与の変更はありません。

💹 昇給・賞与 💹

  • 年1回の人事考課があり、経験やプロジェクトへの貢献度に応じて、給与の見直しが行われます。

  • 昇給は、毎年10月～11月頃に、次年度の予算と財務予測に基づき行われます。

  • 年次有給休暇：10日/年（初年度、試用期間終了後付与）

  • 慶弔休暇

  • 病気休暇：年5日（有給、試用期間終了後適用）

🤝 福利厚生 🤝

  • 社会保険

  • 育児休業 ((詳細はこちら)

個人情報の取り扱いについて

今回の応募において個人情報をお送りいただくと、弊社の求職者向けプライバシー通知に則り、ご自身の個人情報が収集、処理されることに同意したとみなされます。詳細につきましては、弊社の求職者向けプライバシー通知( )をご確認ください。

Studio: Wizcorp

Location: Asia Pacific, Tokyo, Japan

Area of Work: Art Services

Service: Create

Employment Type: Full Time

Working Pattern: Remote

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

Keywords Studios is strongly committed to protecting your personal information. By sending your CV/Resume, you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and consent to your data being managed and retained in accordance with our data privacy and retention policy

Wizcorpについて 🦄🇯🇵🎮

Wizcorpは東京を拠点とし、100%リモートワークで運営される高度に専門化されたゲーム開発スタジオです。私たちは異文化が融合する情熱的なチームとして、ひとつの目標に向かって取り組んでいます。それは、ゲーム開発に魔法を取り戻すこと。

私たちの取り組み

  • 日々成長する: 技術力が私たちのアイデアを制限することがあってはならない

  • 常識を疑う: 昨日の答えで明日の課題に立ち向かうことはしない

  • 価値観を大切にする: 私たちの意思決定は、道徳的な指針に導かれている

  • 同じビジョンを持つ仲間と: スタッフ、クライアント、パートナーすべてが私たちのミッションの一部

  • 学び、共有する: 私たちの成功も失敗も、業界全体の知恵に貢献していく

Wizcorpは、フレンドリーで誠実な職場環境を提供しています。やりがいのある仕事を通じて、個人としても専門家としても成長できる機会が無数にあります。

jobs.title: Senior Staff Full-stack Engineer (Remote-Eligible) - Global Payment Network
jobs.excerpt: Senior Staff Full-stack Engineer (Remote-Eligible) - Global Payment NetworkAs a Senior Staff Engineer at Capital One, you will be part of a community of technical experts working to define the future of banking in the cloud.
jobs.description:
Senior Staff Full-stack Engineer (Remote-Eligible) - Global Payment Network

As a Senior Staff Engineer at Capital One, you will be part of a community of technical experts working to define the future of banking in the cloud. You will work alongside our talented team of developers, machine learning experts, product managers and people leaders. Our Senior Staff Engineers are leading experts in their domains, helping devise practical and reusable solutions to complex problems. You will drive innovation at multiple levels, helping optimize business outcomes while delivering strong technology solutions.


At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will promote a culture of engineering excellence and strike the right balance between lending expertise and providing an inclusive environment where the ideas of others can be heard and championed. You will lead the way in creating next-generation talent for Capital One Tech, mentoring engineers and actively recruiting to keep building our community.


Senior Staff Engineers are expected to lead through technical contribution. You will operate as a trusted advisor for our key technologies, platforms and capability domains, creating clear and concise communications, code samples, blog posts and other materials to share knowledge both inside and outside the organization. You will specialize in a particular subject area, but your input and impact will be sought and expected throughout the organization.


About the Team: The Global Payment Network (GPN) Technology organization designs, builds, and operates the mission-critical systems and infrastructure that seamlessly power complex money movement across domestic and international rails. We build and operate a high-volume, low-latency, and highly resilient distributed ecosystem that is simultaneously secure, performant, accurate, and nimble.

As an engineer in the Global Payment Network, you will apply your technical acumen to shape and deliver solutions to complex problems at massive scale. You will engineer solutions across core network products, simplify global participant integration, and rapidly deliver new features. Leveraging automation and AI-native engineering, you will unlock real-time insights and advance our capabilities in domains ranging from high-throughput transaction processing to advanced fraud and risk mitigation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Articulate and evangelize a bold technical vision for your domain
  • Decompose complex problems into practical and operational solutions
  • Ensure the quality of technical design and implementation
  • Serve as an authoritative expert on non-functional system characteristics, such as performance, scalability and operability
  • Continue learning and injecting advanced technical knowledge into our community
  • Handle several projects simultaneously, balancing your time to maximize impact
  • Act as a role model and mentor within the tech community, helping to coach and strengthen the technical expertise and know-how of our engineering and product community
  • Drive modernization of monolithic systems into microservice architectures and event-driven platforms

  • Serve as a force-multiplier for the team, balancing deep, hands-on technical contribution and innovation with mentoring and elevating the skills of peers and junior engineers.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SINCH Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SINCH

Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 200,000 businesses - including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others - rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.

Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.

At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!

DESCRIPTION

Sinch provides API-based messaging, voice, and email capabilities that customers integrate into applications, workflows, data platforms, contact centers, and AI systems.

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to make those integrations work in the real world. You will embed with customer engineering and operations teams, use modern AI development tools to build production software rapidly, integrate it into existing technology stacks, and lead complex technical deployments to measurable outcomes. You are a production software engineer, customer solution architect, and technical delivery lead, accountable for making the customer solution work in production.

During product ramp-up and early customer engagements, you will work closely with named Voice, Messaging, and Email subject-matter experts. These SMEs provide deep guidance on product capabilities, solution fit, provisioning, country requirements, configuration, best practices, limitations, and complex product-level troubleshooting. Over time, you are expected to become self-sufficient in routine delivery across the supported Sinch CPaaS scope. Ongoing SME involvement focuses on keeping FDEs current with changes in products, technologies, markets, and use cases, and on exceptional deep-domain issues.

Engagements favor supported, generally available Sinch APIs and repeatable implementation patterns. The goal is to accelerate the customer into production and leave its engineering team able to operate and extend the implementation, not to create a permanent dependency on the FDE team.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Help qualify the engagement. Evaluate technical readiness, feasibility, customer ownership, likely adoption, product gaps, and repeatability. Provide evidence and recommendations to the FDE lead and commercial owner, who make engagement and continued-investment decisions.

  • Lead technical delivery end to end. Run discovery, map workflows and dependencies, define measurable success and sign-off criteria, create the delivery plan, and own execution from prototype through production stabilization and handoff.

  • Design the solution. Translate business workflows into architectures that combine Sinch messaging, voice, or email APIs with customer applications, identity, data, events, AI systems, cloud platforms, and third-party services.

  • Build with AI and remain accountable. Use coding agents and AI-enabled development tools for codebase discovery, implementation, refactoring, tests, troubleshooting, and documentation. Validate generated output for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and customer fit.

  • Integrate into the customer stack. Write production-grade services, webhook handlers, adapters, data mappings, deployment automation, tests, and operational tooling in the customer's preferred environment.

  • Engineer for production. Design for capacity, scalability, availability, resilience, idempotency, retries, timeouts, rate limits, backpressure, secrets management, least privilege, and safe failure modes.

  • Prove quality. Create unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, load, resilience, and failover tests. Validate business workflows, API and event behavior, recovery, migration, and rollback.

  • Make the system observable. Instrument structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, and cross-system correlation using Sinch identifiers, callbacks, delivery events, product telemetry, and protocol evidence where relevant.

  • Navigate security and compliance. Partner with customer security, privacy, legal, and communications teams on authentication, data handling, consent, regional requirements, channel regulations, and architecture review.

  • Drive adoption and handoff. Train customer engineers, document architecture and runbooks, establish ownership, and leave the customer able to operate and extend its implementation.

  • Use named SMEs deliberately. Rely heavily on assigned SMEs during ramp-up and early engagements. Bring evidence, absorb their guidance, and document what was learned. Become self-sufficient in routine delivery, using SMEs thereafter to stay current with product, technology, market, and use-case changes and for exceptional deep-domain issues.

  • Turn field evidence into product improvement. Provide Product and Engineering with reproducible findings, customer impact, recommended changes, and reusable implementation patterns that improve APIs, documentation, tooling, and defaults.

THE TECHNICAL SURFACE

Your primary depth should be in production software delivery, enterprise integration, and operations. You are not expected to arrive as a deep expert in Voice, Messaging, and Email. You must bring meaningful exposure to at least one communications domain, learn adjacent products rapidly with named SME support during ramp-up, become self-sufficient in routine delivery, and know when material changes or unusual complexity require specialist input.

  • AI-assisted software delivery: coding agents and AI-enabled development environments used for discovery, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, review, and documentation, with human verification and engineering accountability throughout

  • Enterprise integration: REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous events, identity and access, data mapping, queues, event buses, CRMs, contact centers, data stores, legacy services, and customer-specific operating standards

  • Production engineering: automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers or serverless, scalability, resilience, performance, secrets, logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, incident response, and operational handoff

  • Voice: Voice APIs and callbacks, call flows, PSTN, SIP and WebRTC concepts, numbers, routing, recording, streaming, and common signaling, media, or network dependencies

  • Messaging: SMS, MMS, RCS, WhatsApp and Conversation API patterns; senders, templates, provisioning, delivery events, opt-in, country requirements, routing, and channel limitations

  • Email: API and SMTP sending, domains and DNS authentication, templates, webhooks, deliverability, bounces, complaints, suppressions, reputation, and regional processing

  • Customer deployment platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, containers, serverless, or on-premises environments, including regional placement, data residency, secrets, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code

REQUIREMENTS

  • Typically 7+ years of professional experience across software engineering, enterprise integration, solution delivery, or technical consulting, including substantial direct work with enterprise customers. Equivalent depth matters more than a specific degree or title.

  • A record of personally architecting, building, deploying, operating, and supporting API-driven production systems, not only presenting demos or handing designs to another team.

  • Strong production software skills in at least one relevant stack such as TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, or C#/.NET, with sound API, event-driven, authentication, security, testing, code-review, and maintainability practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to use coding agents or other AI development tools to accelerate working software, tests, troubleshooting, and documentation while independently validating the results.

  • Experience integrating new software into existing enterprise technology stacks, including APIs, webhooks, data stores, identity systems, cloud services, events, and operational processes.

  • Strong command of testing, scalability, and observability, including automated test strategy, capacity and failure-mode design, structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting, and cross-system correlation.

  • Experience deploying services on at least one major cloud platform using modern delivery practices such as Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers or serverless, secrets management, and regional design.

  • Meaningful exposure to at least one communications domain such as programmable voice, messaging, or email. Experience across multiple domains is valuable but is not required.

  • Ability to learn adjacent CPaaS products rapidly with heavy initial support from named SMEs, then apply that guidance independently in normal delivery work.

  • Clear written and verbal communication across engineers, product specialists, security reviewers, business owners, and executives, including the ability to teach and create shared clarity under pressure.

  • Delivery judgment under ambiguity: scope an MVP, make tradeoffs, surface risks early, protect the critical path, and remain calm during planned cutovers and production stabilization.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 10-15% and support planned customer workshops and cutovers. This is not a standing customer-support or on-call assignment.

Preferred

  • Hands-on production experience with a CPaaS provider or comparable communications API platform.

  • Depth in one or more of programmable Voice, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, Email, Numbers, Verification, SIP trunking, or related communications technologies.

  • Experience with AI-native companies, conversational AI, agentic systems, speech technologies, or real-time AI integrations.

  • Deep Voice and SIP troubleshooting, messaging-channel provisioning, or email-deliverability expertise.

  • Experience connecting communications APIs with CRMs, contact centers, data platforms, decision engines, or AI systems.

  • Experience creating reusable implementation assets, mentoring engineers, or influencing a product roadmap from field evidence.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.

We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Benefits

  • STAY HEALTHY: We offer comprehensive market competitive medical, dental, and vision plans. A variety of supplemental plans are also provided to meet your individual needs including access to telehealth for all participants.

  • CARE FOR YOURSELF: Take advantage of our free virtual counselling resources through our global Employee Assistance Program. Your mental health is as important as your physical health.

  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Plan for your future with our Roth and Pre-tax 401(k) options including an employer match for all participants.

  • TAKE A BREAK: Enjoy a generous paid time off program. We value balance and understand that performance at work requires time to rest at home and/or rejuvenate on vacation.

  • PUT FAMILY FIRST: We know that families can be built in a variety of ways; therefore, we offer paid parental leave and family planning support.

  • WORK WHEREVER: Our flexible remote work offerings allow you to work wherever you are the most productive and successful. It is what you do, not where you work, that matters.

  • MAKE AN IMPACT: Support betterment in your community and beyond by taking paid time off to support a volunteer program of your choice.

The annual starting salary for this position is between $155,000 - $186,000. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications. This role will be accepting applications until October 5, 2026 at a minimum. Please note that the application timeline may be flexible to accommodate a comprehensive candidate evaluation.

jobs.description:
About the role:
We are building a greenfield, document-driven lending platform that automates the full lifecycle of a loan application — from document intake and OCR-based extraction, through human-in-the-loop review, to final approval and downstream submission. The system is a modular monolith with a clear separation between backend services and multiple trust-boundaried web front ends, deployed natively on Azure.
We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer who is equally comfortable designing clean, testable back-end architecture in C#/.NET and building modern, production-grade UI in React/Next.js. You'll work across the stack: domain modeling, API design, background/async processing, and customer- and operations-facing web applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build business logic and domain modules in an ASP.NET Core API following Clean Architecture principles (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API layers).
  • Build and maintain asynchronous background processing services (a .NET worker) for document-heavy workflows, coordinated through message queues.
  • Develop and maintain multiple Next.js/React applications serving different user populations (internal operations/back-office tooling and external/customer-facing portals), sharing a common package layer.
  • Design relational data models and write efficient data access code (EF Core / PostgreSQL).
  • Integrate with cloud-native infrastructure: message queues, blob storage, secrets management, and managed identity providers.
  • Implement authentication and authorization across multiple identity boundaries (workforce vs. external/customer identity).
  • Collaborate on API contracts and shared TypeScript types consumed by front-end applications.
  • Participate in architectural decisions that keep a growing monolith modular, maintainable, and well-tested (unit, integration, contract, and architecture tests).
  • Work within a human-in-the-loop product model: build tooling that lets operators review, correct, and approve AI-assisted extraction results, with full traceability of how each data point changed from raw intake to final approval.
  • Write and maintain automated tests across the stack and participate in CI/CD pipeline health.
  • Participate in code review, technical design discussions, and mentor less experienced engineers.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core).
  • 4+ years building production front-end applications with React, including Next.js (App Router, server components/actions, route handlers).
  • Strong understanding of Clean/Layered Architecture, domain modeling, and separation of concerns in non-trivial back-end systems.
  • Experience with relational databases and ORMs (EF Core or equivalent), including migrations and query performance.
  • Solid TypeScript skills and comfort working in a monorepo with shared, versioned internal packages.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP equivalents considered) — messaging/queues, object storage, secrets management.
  • Experience implementing or integrating OAuth2/OIDC-based authentication, ideally with enterprise identity providers (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID or similar).
  • Strong automated testing discipline: unit, integration, and contract testing on both back end and front end.
  • Comfortable working across the full stack without hand-offs — from database schema to API to UI.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working in a small, senior, high-autonomy engineering team.

Compétences fonctionnelles

jobs.description:
Mission Telecom is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit wireless broadband provider and grantmaking foundation. We partner with nonprofits, schools, and libraries to close the digital divide through reliable, affordable wireless broadband and connected devices, and through Mission Telecom Giving, we fund social impact organizations working to advance equity and justice. Our grantmaking focuses on multiracial democracy, movement infrastructure and innovation, and telecom justice, including broadband affordability policy.

About the Role

Mission Telecom is seeking a Senior .NET Full-Stack Engineer to develop and support software systems, integrations, and automations across the organization. A central focus is Mission Connect, our custom business application supporting sales, customer management, billing, payments, fulfillment, and operational workflows. Mission Connect is nearing its initial production launch with an established architecture, automated testing and deployment controls, and defined engineering standards. After launch, this position will assume primary engineering ownership of the platform.

This is a broad, hands-on role spanning full-stack development, integrations, PostgreSQL, security, Azure operations, and production support. The role reports to the CTO, who remains actively involved in architecture, priorities, release planning, and technical escalation, and works directly with leadership and business stakeholders to turn operational needs into reliable software.

Key Responsibilities

Application Development and Business Automation

  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and support Mission Telecom software applications using C#, .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, Blazor Server, Radzen, and related technologies.
  • Build staff and customer-facing interfaces, application services, business logic, background processing, and data-access functionality.
  • Serve as the primary hands-on engineer for software systems, partnering with the CTO and business stakeholders on priorities, technical decisions, and release planning.
  • Own the technical design and implementation of assigned application features and enhancements within Mission Telecom's established technology direction.
  • Translate business processes and operational requirements into automated workflows supporting grantmaking, marketing, lead management, sales, billing, payments, fulfillment, customer service, reporting, and other organizational functions.
  • Deliver maintainable, incremental enhancements to existing applications and workflows.
  • Develop scripts, utilities, and automation for data exchange, system administration, diagnostics, deployment, integration support, and operational tasks.
  • Own assigned work from requirements and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and support.

APIs and System Integrations

  • Design, build, maintain, and troubleshoot secure integrations between internal and third-party systems.
  • Develop and consume REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, file-based exchanges, and other system-to-system integration methods.
  • Support integrations across CRM, marketing, lead generation, advertising, analytics, accounting, payments, communications, and telecom platforms, including systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Apollo.io, RB2B, Google, Meta, NetSuite, payment processors, and service providers.
  • Implement reliable patterns for authentication, synchronization, error handling, retries, rate limits, duplicate prevention, and reconciliation.
  • Diagnose and resolve integration issues across applications, data, authentication, and third-party platforms.
  • Design integrations that can adapt as Mission Telecom's business systems and processes evolve.

Databases and Financial Systems

  • Design, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize PostgreSQL and other databases supporting Mission Telecom.
  • Work with relational data models, tables, relationships, primary and foreign keys, constraints, indexes, SQL queries, Entity Framework Core, and application data access.
  • Diagnose database performance, concurrency, and data-integrity issues.
  • Plan and execute controlled database schema changes using established migration, validation, and deployment practices.
  • Develop and support financial and operational workflows involving orders, invoices, payments, taxes, adjustments, refunds, provisioning, and customer accounts.
  • Build and maintain NetSuite and payment processor integrations with appropriate transaction integrity, auditability, and reconciliation.
  • Maintain appropriate customer data isolation and financial correctness across billing, tax, payment, and reconciliation workflows.

Security and Identity

  • Develop and maintain authentication, authorization, and role-based access controls.
  • Configure and support Microsoft Entra ID capabilities used by applications, including app registrations, enterprise applications, permissions, managed identities, secrets, and certificates.
  • Work with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and related identity standards.
  • Apply secure development practices to customer information, financial data, APIs, file handling, application access, and cloud resources.

Azure Operations and Software Quality

  • Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and support applications and services within Microsoft Azure.
  • Work with Azure App Service, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Application Insights, managed identities, networking, configuration, logging, and related services.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD processes using GitHub and GitHub Actions or comparable tooling.
  • Own application monitoring, incident investigation, recovery procedures, and root-cause resolution, with the CTO providing technical backup and escalation support.
  • Develop and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end automated testing for business-critical workflows.
  • Use Playwright or comparable tools to validate important staff and customer workflows.
  • Perform code reviews and maintainappropriate technical documentation for applications, integrations, configuration, and support procedures.

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Use AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to improve productivity across analysis, development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code review.
  • Work within a structured AI-assisted development process that uses scoped tasks, review checkpoints, independent validation, and documented review before release.
  • Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Independently understand the codebase, design solutions, write and modify production code, and troubleshoot issues without reliance on generated output.
  • Use AI tools within approved security and data-handling requirements and independently verify generated work before release.

What Success Looks Like

  • Mission Connect stable and supported in production, with engineering ownership fully transitioned from leadership
  • Business requests delivered as working enhancements and automations on a consistent release schedule
  • Reliable integrations, with errors caught and resolved quickly
  • Accurate, auditable billing, payment, and reconciliation workflows
  • Production issues resolved at the root cause, with decreasing reliance on CTO escalation over time
  • Current automated test coverage and documentation for business-critical workflows

What You'll Need

  • 7 or more years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience building and supporting complex production business applications.
  • Advanced proficiency with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and modern full-stack web application development.
  • Proven ability to design, build, and support REST APIs and integrations with third-party business systems.
  • Proficiency with SQL, relational database design, data modeling, indexes, keys, query optimization, and database troubleshooting.
  • Experience building and supporting business-critical transactional or operational applications where data accuracy, reliability, and auditability matter.
  • Ability to translate business processes and requirements into reliable software solutions and independently own delivery through release and support.
  • Knowledge of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, and secure development practices.
  • Experience deploying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting cloud-hosted applications and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Effective communication and problem-solving skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted development tools productively while independently understanding, reviewing, troubleshooting, and writing production code.

Nice to Have

Experience with every listed platform is not required. Candidates should demonstrate the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar applications, APIs, and integration requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Annual salary of $120,000 to $140,000 based on experience and qualifications
  • Fully paid medical, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, and life/AD&D insurance
  • 85% of dependent coverage for medical, dental, and vision
  • Partial phone and internet reimbursement
  • 5% Safe Harbor contribution into a 401(k)
  • Unlimited PTO plus 14 paid holidays per year

Our Culture

Mission Telecom fosters an environment of innovation, collaboration, and purpose-driven work. We align ourselves with staff, partners, and clients who are passionate about creating measurable impact and expanding access to opportunity.

Apply through this posting by October 21, 2026. Please include a cover letter and resume showcasing your experience relevant to this position.

At Carrum, we are transforming how we pay for, deliver and experience healthcare. Team Management & Collaboration (50%)

Data Operations, Security, & Compliance (25%)

  • HIPAA & Compliance: Ensure all data operations and infrastructure adhere strictly to healthcare regulatory requirements, including HIPAA and other relevant data privacy standards.
  • Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain robust backup, recovery, and business continuity plans for critical data assets.

Data Strategy & Engineering Leadership (25%)

  • Architect and Build: Lead the design and implementation of scalable, reliable, and performant ETL/ELT data pipelines and data warehouse solutions that meet the demands of a growing organization.
  • Multi-Cloud Infrastructure: Own and optimize the data infrastructure across AWS and Azure cloud environments, ensuring interoperability, cost efficiency, and robust security.
  • Technology Expertise: Drive the selection and adoption of best-in-class data technologies, including modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Azure Synapse), orchestration tools (e.g., AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory), and real-time streaming solutions.
  • Code Quality: Set and enforce standards for code quality, testing, version control (Git), and documentation for all data engineering projects.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (Master’s preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with at least 2 years in a management or technical leadership role.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure cloud platforms and their respective data services (e.g., AWS S3, EMR, Redshift, Lambda; Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Data Factory).
  • Expert proficiency in SQL, Python, and experience with modern data warehousing/data lake concepts.
  • You are AI-native: You champion AI developer productivity tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot) daily to accelerate your workflow and mentor the team on effective AI-assisted development.
  • Demonstrable experience working with sensitive healthcare data (e.g., PHI, EMR/EHR, Claims data) and ensuring HIPAA compliance.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with a major orchestration tool like Apache Airflow or similar.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

We’re excited about you because you have

  • An innate curiosity, an eye for detail, and excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. You stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in data engineering.
  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team coupled with strong communication skills, both written (documentation and comments) and verbal.
  • A relative comfort with ambiguity and a mission driven mindset which makes you proactively seek to make things more smooth and scalable, rather than waiting for a solution to be dictated.
  • An entrepreneurial spirit and an ability to innovate and solve problems creatively and strategically.
  • Knowledge of healthcare tech industry and/or medical/pharmacy claims is a strong plus.
  • A passion for Carrum Health’s mission to make healthcare more affordable and consumer-centric, one bundle at a time.

Why you’ll love working with us...

  • We’re a hard-working, humble, and compassionate group motivated to solve the hard problems in healthcare today. You’ll work with talented, experienced co-workers from companies like Booz & Company, Livongo, 98point6, Google, and Optum. We’re a remote-first company with employees all over the United States and two office locations in San Francisco and Chicago. We support our employees during the work day and beyond with flexible working hours, generous time off, paid parental leave, and opportunities to connect with coworkers both virtually and in-person.

Carrum has an active employee-led Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Justice (DEIJ) committee and several employee resource groups (ERGs). Our ERGS help employees build stronger connections through social, educational, and community activities.

  • Chicago and San Francisco offices available

We’re a health tech company that brings value-based care to the masses. The Data Centre of Excellence (DCoE) requires a Senior Data Architect to support the delivery of key roadmap items for the OneData Alberta and Crosswalk initiatives.

As a Principal Software Engineer focused on R&D within Resideo’s Innovation organization, you will help build the next generation of software platforms that enable intelligent, connected experiences across the home.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for an engineer with a strong software systems background who enjoys solving complex problems from the ground up. You will contribute to the architecture and development of an edge computing runtime and integration platform, helping create a software foundation that can understand connected devices and their data, build a richer model of the home, especially spatial and occupancy information, and make that information available to applications, edge workloads, and intelligent agents.

You’ll work in an R&D environment where the path isn’t always predefined. The role is focused around exploring new ideas, rapidly learning unfamiliar technologies, building prototypes and production-quality systems, and helping determine which concepts are worth taking further.

JOB DUTIES

  • Architect, design, and build core components of Resideo’s next-generation edge computing and spatial intelligence platforms.

  • Develop an edge runtime and integration platform capable of bringing together data and capabilities from connected devices across the home.

  • Help build software models and knowledge structures that make device and home information usable by other systems, including edge applications, mobile experiences, and intelligent agents.

  • Take complex technical problems from concept through prototype and implementation, helping the team quickly test, learn, and iterate.

  • Evaluate technologies and architectural approaches based on scalability, reliability, performance, portability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Serve as a technical leader within the team, providing architectural guidance, reviewing code and designs, and establishing strong software engineering practices.

  • Work closely with engineers across Innovation, IoT systems, mobile, embedded firmware, and other technical disciplines.

  • Contribute to R&D planning by identifying opportunities, shaping technical concepts, communicating recommendations, and helping turn promising ideas into new projects.

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture focused on thoughtful experimentation and high-quality execution.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 10+ years of experience in technology environments, with hands-on software development experience in compiled programming languages (such as Rust, C/C++, or Go).

  • Software systems engineering experience (in areas such as databases, operating systems, compilers, networking, cybersecurity, virtualization) focused on building foundational technology.

  • Experience working in a R&D, advanced development, prototyping, or similarly exploratory technical environment.

WE VALUE

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain technical needs, architectural decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

  • Experience taking ideas from prototype to product.

  • Experience with Rust, or a strong interest in becoming highly proficient with Rust.

  • Experience designing or building foundational software systems such as databases, operating systems, compilers, runtimes, network stacks, protocols, or similar infrastructure.

  • Networking and network protocol development experience.

  • Cybersecurity or secure systems development experience.

  • Experience with edge computing, distributed systems, or resource-constrained computing environments.

  • Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic technologies, or other approaches to representing relationships between systems and data.

  • Experience developing or integrating intelligent agents or agent-based systems.

  • Experience with Internet of Things (IoT) technologies and connected-device ecosystems.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, including technologies such as Yocto, or experience with embedded RTOS environments.

  • Experience with asynchronous programming.

  • Experience with containers, WebAssembly, virtualization, or application portability technologies.

  • End-to-end platform development experience.

  • Experience with robust software quality, testing, version control, and continuous integration practices.

  • Experience with a major cloud platform; Resideo uses Azure.

  • A track record of learning from previous architectural or technical approaches and applying those lessons to future system design.

  • Comfortably moving between exploration and execution, with the ability to pivot quickly as new information emerges, and are willing to challenge or adapt processes when doing so helps the team move forward.

  • Self-direction while still actively participating in team planning and technical discussions.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Help create foundational technology for the next generation of connected-home experiences.

jobs.description:
We're currently hiring for remote team members in the following states: DC, DE, GA, MA, MD, NC, NH, NJ, OH, PA, SC, UT, and VA.

We're AWeber, a remote‑first company that helps small businesses around the world form meaningful connections with their customers and grow their businesses using our marketing communication software. We are fanatical about small businesses and we hope you are too!

At AWeber, agentic development is core to how we build. Our engineers spend most of their time designing agents and agentic engineering systems, reviewing agent‑generated work for quality and correctness, and coordinating that work across the codebase. As an Engineering Team Lead, you build a small team of engineers who do exactly that into a high‑performing, healthy, well‑functioning group, and you lead them from inside the work.

This is a player‑coach role. You run 1:1s, grow careers, own hiring and reviews for your team, and own its delivery and quality bar. You also stay hands‑on: designing solutions, reviewing agent output on the risky paths, and shipping the hard parts yourself. We are not looking for someone who leaves the code behind. We are looking for the senior engineer other people already rely on, who leads and grows a team without losing their own hands on the keyboard. Your mission is to help a capable, curious group ship work the org can trust, move quickly without cutting corners, and consistently finish what they start.

On any given day, you could be found reviewing an agent‑generated pull request on a risky path and coaching the engineer on how they verified it, running a 1:1 that turns someone's recurring frustration into an owned initiative, interviewing a candidate and sharpening how your team evaluates new hires, pairing for an hour to unblock a stalled migration, deciding what comes off the plate so your team is not underwater, or carrying your team's priorities into a cross‑team engineering forum.

You'll thrive as an Engineering Team Lead if you

  • Lead from inside the work, stay hands‑on in the code, and measure success by your team's output and growth rather than your own.
  • Have a bias to action, turning recurring problems into owned, dated, shipped solutions instead of letting good ideas recirculate.
  • Treat verification and trust as the real throughput limit in an AI‑first org, and hold the line on quality without stalling momentum.
  • Make people decisions and difficult trade‑offs with care, and own the outcomes.
  • Establish standards and inspire others, not just through your own expertise but through mentorship and advocacy.
  • Default to open, transparent communication, and adapt your message to engineers, peers, product partners, and leadership.
  • Stay calm and steady when priorities compete, and keep your team oriented on what matters most.
  • Stay a forever learner, and grow the people around you.

Required skills and qualifications

  • 7+ years in hands‑on software engineering roles, with real depth on the backend (Python) or the front end (React, TypeScript, or modern JavaScript frameworks), and the judgment to review and improve both engineers' and agent‑generated code.
  • 1+ year in a technical lead, team lead, or hands‑on project management role, with a track record of mentoring and growing engineers. We are open to a strong first‑time people manager who has been a de facto lead.
  • Experience owning a team's delivery: setting direction, breaking down ambiguous work, holding people accountable to commitments, and driving projects to done.
  • Demonstrated ability to design solutions with AI development tools and coding assistants, and to raise a team's standard for reviewing agent‑generated work.
  • Strong experience across our stack: Python, React, and TypeScript, plus databases, caching strategies, UNIX development tools, and deploying to AWS or other cloud infrastructure.
  • Readiness to own the people work of a lead: performing reviews, interviewing and evaluating candidates, and developing careers.
  • A track record of turning recurring problems into owned, shared solutions, and of managing projects cross‑functionally to deadline in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to inspire and mentor engineers across experience levels.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading delivery in a high‑volume agentic or AI‑assisted codebase, including the verification, trust, and code‑review challenges that come with it.
  • Experience in a remote‑first, asynchronous engineering culture.
  • Background in one of our domains: email or marketing SaaS, web platforms, backend services, or front‑end at scale.
  • Familiarity with application monitoring, metrics, performance tuning, and scaling web applications, plus Test Driven Development, release management, and QA practices you can champion across a team.
  • Experience with vendor relationship management for software, services, or external consultants.
  • A record of developing others' AI and agentic capability through working sessions, documentation, or reusable patterns.
  • Experience running a team through a migration or platform shift without stalling delivery, and an understanding of open source contribution and licensing.

AWeber Benefits

jobs.title: Product Manager, Developer Platform - Application Development Platforms
jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Developer Platform sits within the Infrastructure Engineering organization to amplify the productivity and business impact of Netflix engineers by providing a cohesive developer platform that optimizes developer experience, automates workflows, manages complexity, and accelerates the development, delivery, operations, and maintenance of high-quality software. Our mission is to enable Netflix to scale effectively and evolve rapidly by providing highly reliable, performant, secure, and flexible developer tools, services, and infrastructure. Ultimately, we aim for Netflix engineers to spend less time on repetitive engineering tasks, unnecessary complexity, and undifferentiated heavy lifting so they can focus on helping Netflix entertain the world.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly technical product manager to drive the vision and strategy for our Application Development Platforms within our centrally supported language ecosystems: Java, JavaScript/TypeScript and Python. The initial focus will be on the Java ecosystem with expansion over time to other languages and ecosystems.

Your primary mission is to keep developers in the flow during application development for the thousands of existing services, data processing jobs and user interfaces as well as the dozens that are created each day. You will deliver well defined and supported golden paths for developers that reduce cognitive load, increase software delivery velocity, improve reliability and alleviate the toil of software maintenance.

You will be responsible for the core components that enable this development, including:

  • Application frameworks (i.e. Spring Boot, React, FastAPI)

  • Build & test systems (i.e. Gradle, Vite, Junit, uv, TestContainers, pytest, Jest)

  • Libraries SDLC and dependency management

  • Stability, Performance, and Adoption of the latest supported runtime, frameworks and tools

What You Will Do

As the Product Manager for Application Development Platforms, you will have the following responsibilities:

  • Drive Product Vision and Strategy: Deeply understand and triangulate across customer needs, developer productivity metrics, operational data, and external industry innovation to shape the vision and strategy for Netflix’s JVM ecosystem and Java application development offerings, ensuring they maximize business and developer impact.

  • Roadmap & Alignment: Partner closely with senior engineering leaders and stakeholders to define a forward-looking roadmap. Align on priorities and trade-offs that support Netflix’s technology strategy.

  • Execution & Delivery: Develop product roadmaps in partnership with engineering teams that execute on your vision. Clearly articulate problems to be solved, and see features through from idea to launch.

  • Metrics-Driven Improvement: Define key success measures (e.g., build times, time to deploy, framework migration progress, performance metrics) and drive experiments or initiatives to continuously improve those metrics, fostering a metrics-driven mindset for developer productivity.

  • User Engagement: Create strong partnerships with Netflix engineers through regular outreach and feedback loops. Gather input via interviews, surveys, and usage data to deeply understand their workflow challenges. Champion the voice of the developer.

  • Technical Excellence & Reliability: Drive technical excellence in our Java application framework and runtime systems. Ensure these systems are highly reliable, secure, and performant.

  • Industry Awareness & Build vs. Buy: Stay informed about advancements in languages ecosystems, application frameworks, and build tooling. Evaluate opportunities to incorporate cutting-edge tools or practices and conduct thoughtful buy-vs-build analyses.

  • Prioritization & Focus: Prioritize effectively to maximize impact, balancing quick wins with foundational investments, and user experience improvements with technical scalability. Maintain clarity on short-term vs. long-term goals.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Skills:

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience (or equivalent technical role), with a proven track record of managing and evolving a broad product portfolio and driving product vision and strategy in a complex, technical domain.

  • Strong technical knowledge and depth of application development fundamentals, the JVM ecosystem, modern application frameworks, build systems, and dependency management methodologies.

  • A healthy blend of deep technical knowledge with a customer-focused mindset and empathy for engineers. You must be comfortable discussing topics like design trade-offs and system quality attributes (scalability, reliability, performance, security) with engineering teams.

  • Demonstrated passion for developer platforms, tools, workflows, and infrastructure, staying up-to-date on industry best practices in DevOps/DevEx.

  • Strategic thinking that can connect customer use cases and pain points to innovative technology solutions, thinking holistically about the end-to-end experience.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and navigate complex organizational boundaries.

  • Comfortable applying a combination of qualitative and quantitative methods to define success, prioritize problems, and measure impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity of thought and background builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Our culture is unique, and we live by our values, so it’s worth learning more about Netflix culture.

jobs.description:
About Tarteel

Tarteel was founded with one mission: to strengthen the relationship Muslims have with the Quran. This goal has been at the very heart of Tarteel since its creation, and we continue to strive to provide the proper tools to empower the Muslim ummah to better connect with the words of Allah SWT, nourishing their faith in doing so. Inspired by the Islamic Golden Age, we saw untapped potential in the area of religious technology. We built Tarteel to help Muslims improve their Quranic study using the best digital tools. The Quran is a journey, and Tarteel is your companion.

The Tarteel app has more than 20M downloads and is powered by our state of the art models. As a company we've established relationships with leading AI companies such as Nvidia, who has us as a featured customer: . We currently have a core team of 20 exceptionally talented individuals.

What we're looking for

Tarteel is building the tools and resources to support and accelerate the work of the next generation of Muslim developers. Our primary open source toolkit, Quranic Universal Library (QUL), provides developers with all the resources and assets they need to build Islamic applications and is currently used by 100s of apps serving millions of users around the world.

As a developer advocate, you’ll help developers make the most of QUL by providing them with guides, tutorials, and platform improvements that will help them utilize the resources to their full potential. You’ll encourage others to get involved in the ecosystem by administrating grants for project bounties, as well as champion those who have added value to the ecosystem.

You are someone that has strong communication skills, both oral and written, and ideally have existing experience working with developers. You should also be able to collect and provide feedback from external stakeholders and share them internally to help scope and prioritize our open source resources roadmap and development.

Responsibilities

  • Design and administer a grants program. This will include writing and reviewing project proposals and selection/acceptance criteria, identifying ways to attract applicants, and keeping them in close contact during and after the grant period.
  • Create technical content demonstrating how to quickly build real projects on top of Tarteel’s open source software (OSS), including blog posts, tutorials, and sample code.
  • Identify and create documentation and functional changes that improve usability of QUL.
  • Champion the community and highlight community members’ work.
  • Evangelize Tarteel’s OSS and the broader ecosystem by creating content such as short posts and videos for distribution on X and other networked channels.
  • Engage with developers through forums, social media, and webinars.
  • Identify and prioritize resource gaps within the Islamic software ecosystem.
  • Represent Tarteel at Muslim developer events and hackathons.
  • Independently seek and discover novel opportunities for collaboration with other developers in the ecosystem and encourage their usage of and contribution to Tarteel’s OSS.
  • Increase discoverability of Tarteel’s OSS, such as by making QUL the top repo when searching for “Quran” on GitHub.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years working in a developer relations role or similar
  • Fluent English Proficiency
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience creating digital content (videos, presentations, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Github Issues and Projects
  • Proficiency with a frontend-based framework for demos (React, React Native, Vue, etc.)
  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment
  • Availability for meetings from Monday to Thursday between 8am and 12pm Eastern

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Arabic Proficiency
  • Familiarity with Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with open source software or large volunteer-driven projects
  • Experience with AI-based tools for content generation and automation

Benefits

  • Fully remote work - Work anytime, anywhere
  • Dunya + Akhira — Islamic work week + Islamic Holidays and culture
  • Unlimited time off with manager approval
  • Yearly team retreats and off-sites
  • Ability to work in your thobe/abaya or traditional clothes in the comfort of your own home
  • Work directly with the core founding team, reporting to the CTO

Interview Process

Our interview process for this role consists of three stages:

  1. 60-minute screener
  2. 60-minute technical interview diving into more depth than the screener and also including a live coding problem
  3. 60-minute culture fit interview focused on situational scenarios and personal perspectives

You'll think about how a smart contract design decision ripples outward, to the web app, to the teams operating the system day to day, and ultimately to our end users. You'll collaborate with product, legal, compliance, web, and ops to make sure contracts are technically sound, regulatorily aligned, and genuinely operable by the teams who rely on them day to day. Throughout, you'll favor simple, elegant designs that let us move quickly and safely.

Enlighten is looking for a Senior Platform Delivery & Reliability Engineer to own the rollout of our data lakehouse platform across a large, multi-site government enterprise, currently ~50 production Kubernetes clusters and growing. This role is a rare hybrid of platform engineer, SRE, and delivery lead. You can deploy the platform, debug anything you encounter in the field, feed what you learn back to the engineering teams, and help fix underlying issues in the code base. Just as importantly, you can step back from any individual issue and fix the system that produced it by building the processes, tooling, and communication channels inside Enlighten that make every deployment faster and less painful than the one before it.

You will be a full member of the Infrastructure team, working daily with our Ingest, Query, Application and Testing teams as well as government customers and site personnel. Success in this role looks like: rollouts across the enterprise happen predictably and efficiently, issues found in the field are cataloged, communicated, and resolved quickly, and the friction that slows deployments steadily disappears.

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute deployments and upgrades of the data lakehouse platform across 50 production Kubernetes clusters in customer environments.

  • Enable and improve site reliability for fielded environments: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous reliability improvement.
  • Identify friction and dysfunction in how deployments happen, such as unclear handoffs, communication gaps, and repeated manual work; then design, implement, and institutionalize the processes that eliminate them (release checklists, readiness reviews, escalation paths, cross-team communication cadences).
  • Continuously improve deployment tooling and automation so rollouts become faster, safer, and more repeatable.
  • Coordinate with a large set of stakeholders (the engineering teams, government programs, security, and site personnel) and keep them informed.

Minimum Qualifications

Preferred Requirements
